(b) To nouns to form verbs expressing privation of the thing, quality, or state expressed by the noun, or separation from it; as in un child, un sex. Sometimes particles and participial adjectives formed with this prefix coincide in form with compounds of the negative prefix un- (see 2d Un- ); as in un done (from un do), meaning unfastened, ruined; and un done (from 2d un- and done ) meaning not done, not finished. aeronautical.formation: PIE root *wer- (1)-raise, lift, hold suspended；举起、抬高、悬挂 + PIE root *nau- boat；船 + -ical（形容词后缀）

formalities.definitionCn: n. 正式手续，规定程序；礼节，社交惯例；徒具形式的事项，走过场

lionfish.definitionCn: n. 狮子鱼，即蓑鲉属（Pterois）的一种暖海珊瑚鱼类，体有横纹，鳍条延长，鳍棘有毒

outrageously.formation: out-（向外、超过、完全） + Old English ut "out, without, outside,"；外面、向外、没有 + Latin rabere-"be mad, rave"；发疯、狂言 + -ous（具有某种性质的形容词后缀） + -ly（方式、程度或状态副词后缀；也可构成形容词）

walkable.definitionCn: adj. 适于步行的；可以走去的，步行可达的

walkable.formation: PIE root *wel- (3) "to turn, revolve."；旋转 + -able（可…的形容词后缀）

blessedness.definitionCn: n. 幸福，极度快乐；（宗教）至福，天福

blessedness.formation: blessed（基词） + -ed（过去式或过去分词后缀） + -ness（性质/状态名词后缀）

bruges.definitionCn:

n. （Bruges）（美、丹、比利时）布鲁热斯（人名）
englishDefinitions: a city in northwestern Belgium that is connected by canal to the North Sea; in the 13th century it was a leading member of the Hanseatic League; the old city (known as the City of Bridges) is a popular tourist attraction
bruges.formation: Flemish brug（“桥”），同源于 Proto-Germanic *brugjo；与 English bridge 同源

detox.definitionCn:
n. 排毒；（对吸毒者或酗酒者的）脱瘾治疗
v. （使）脱瘾；戒酒，戒毒；给身体排毒
englishDefinitions: the process of removing harmful substances from your body by only eating and drinking particular things

effortful.definitionCn: adj. 需要（或显示）努力的；费力的
englishDefinitions: requiring great physical effort
effortful.formation: PIE *eghs-out；向外、离开 + Latin fortis "strong, mighty; firm, steadfast; brave, spirited,"；强壮、有力、坚固、勇敢 + -ful（充满/具有…的后缀）

englishDefinitions: an expression of feeling very sad or disappointed
the act of lamenting
lamentation.formation: *la- to shout, cry；呼喊 + -ation（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

slavishly.definitionCn: adv. （多含贬义）奴隶般地，盲目地，一味地
englishDefinitions: in a slavish manner
slavishly.formation: Latin Sclavus-slave；奴隶 + -ly（副词/形容词后缀）

ardently.formation: PIE root *as- to burn, glow；燃烧 + -ly（副词/形容词后缀）

back-to-back.definitionCn: adj. 背靠背的，背对背的；紧接的，连续的

misconceive.definitionCn:

误解
englishDefinitions: to form a wrong idea of (something) : misunderstand
misconceive.formation: Proto-Germanic *missa- "divergent, astray"；偏离、走错方向 + Latin cum "together, together with, in combination,"；一起、共同、结合 + PIE root *kap- to grasp；抓住、掌握 + mis- "badly, wrongly"；错误、坏、误

englishDefinitions: silly and not worth taking seriously
laughable.formation: PIE root *kleg- "to cry, sound."；声音 + -able（“能够……的”形容词后缀）

naturalize.definitionCn:

englishDefinitions: make into a citizen；explain with reference to nature

obsessively.definitionCn: adv. 过分地；着迷地，着魔似地

obsessively.formation: ob- toward; against; before; near; across; down,；朝向、对着；在前、附近、横过或向下 + PIE root *sed- (1) "to sit."；坐 + -ive（具有或倾向于某种性质的形容词后缀） + -ly（副词/形容词后缀）

reoccur.definitionCn: vi. 重新发生，重新出现
englishDefinitions: to occur again : to happen another time : recur
reoccur.formation: Latin re-"again; back; anew, against."；再次、回返、重新；对抗 + ob- toward; against; before; near; across; down,；朝向、对着；在前、附近、横过或向下 + PIE root *kers- to run；跑

tactfully.definitionCn: adv. 巧妙地，机智地，得体地

untouchable.definitionCn: adj. 达不到的；不可批评的；不可捉摸的

untouchable.formation: un-（不、非；反向、取消） + Old English un-prefix of negation；否定前缀，表示“不、非” + Old French tochier "to touch, hit, knock; mention, deal with"；触摸

biometrics.definitionCn: n. 生物识别（技术），生物特征识别：利用指纹、人脸、虹膜、声纹、DNA 等生理或行为特征对个人身份进行识别或认证的技术或方法；生物统计学，生物测定学：运用数学和统计方法分析生物数据、研究生物学现象的学科；寿命统计
englishDefinitions: a branch of biology that studies biological phenomena and observations by means of statistical analysis

contrastive.definitionCn: adj. 对比的，对照的；（语言学）用于对比研究的

escapee.definitionCn: n. 逃亡者，逃犯，逃避者（从某处逃脱的人，尤指从监狱或拘禁场所逃出的人）

escapee.formation: PIE *eghs-out；向外、离开 + Latin caput "head"；头 + -ee（相关人物后缀）

heartbreakingly.formation: PIE root *kerd- heart；心、心脏 + PIE root *bhreg- "to break"；打破、折断 + -ing（动名词/现在分词后缀） + -ly（副词后缀）

tilapia.definitionCn: n. 罗非鱼，非洲鲫鱼；罗非鱼肉
englishDefinitions: a genus of Cichlidae
tilapia.formation: thlapi/thiape（茨瓦纳语“鱼”；拉丁化后形成 tilapia）

achingly.definitionCn: adv. 极其；痛惜地；非常痛地

astronomic.definitionCn: adj. 天文学的，天文的，星学的；极大的，天文数字般的
englishDefinitions: relating or belonging to the science of astronomy；inconceivably large

birdbrain.definitionCn: n. 轻佻的人；轻率浮躁的人；笨蛋

ganglion.definitionCn: n. （解剖学）神经节；（医学）腱鞘囊肿

headstand.definitionCn:

knoxville.definitionCn: n. 诺克斯维尔（美国田纳西州东部城市）

mannerly.definitionCn:

renegotiation.definitionCn: n. 重新谈判；重新商议

echolocation.definitionCn: n. 回声定位，回波定位，回声测距（不可数名词，指动物如蝙蝠、鲸类等发出声波并通过回声确定物体位置、距离和形状的机能）

wariness.definitionCn: n. 谨慎，小心；警惕，戒备

interne.definitionCn: n. 实习医师（intern 的变体拼写）

自我雇佣

undeniably.definitionCn: adv. 不可否认地，确凿无疑地，无可争辩地

oversupply.definitionCn:

erasure.definitionCn: n. 消除；涂擦的痕迹；消磁

geophysicist.definitionCn: n. 地球物理学家，地球物理学者

remoteness.definitionCn: n. 遥远，偏僻；冷漠，疏远；时间久远；细微，渺茫；（法律）损失遥远性，间接损失

aspirant.definitionCn:

decider.definitionCn: n. 决定者，裁决者，决策者；（体育）决胜局，决定胜负的比赛
englishDefinitions: One who decides.
decider.formation: Latin de "down, down from, from, off; concerning"；向下、离开；关于 + PIE root *kae-id- to strike；击打 + -er（比较级/施事名词后缀）

englishDefinitions: a substance that induces hallucinations
hallucinogen.formation: PIE root *leid- or *loid- to play；玩耍 + PIE root *gene- "give birth, beget,"；生育、产生 + -gen（产生、生成）

illiquid.definitionCn: adj. （资产）不可立即兑现的；（市场）参与者少的
englishDefinitions: involving things that cannot easily be changed into cash, or things that are difficult to buy and sell
illiquid.formation: il-（不、非） + PIE root *ne- "not"；不、非 + *wleik- to flow, run；流动 + in- "not"；不、非；进入、向内

illiquidity.definitionCn: n. （金融）非流动性，流动性不足；不能立即付现（的状态）
illiquidity.formation: il-（否定前缀） + *wleik- to flow, run；流动 + -ity（性质或状态抽象名词后缀）

innovational.definitionCn: adj. 革新的，创新的，富有革新精神的
englishDefinitions: being or producing something like nothing done or experienced or created before
innovational.formation: in-（不、非；进入、向内） + PIE root *en "in"；在内、进入 + PIE *newo- new；新 + -ation（动作、过程或结果名词后缀） + -al（形容词后缀）

englishDefinitions: the act or process or an instance of surveying the past
retrospection.formation: Latin retro (prep.) "backward, back, behind,"；在后 + Latin specere-"to look"；看 + PIE root *spek-"to observe"；观察 + -tion（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

riskily.definitionCn: adv. 冒险地，有风险地，危险地；近乎淫秽地，有伤风化地
englishDefinitions: in a dangerously risky manner
riskily.formation: French risque（“风险”） + Italian risco/rischio，来自 riscare（“遭遇危险”）；更早词源未明 + -ly（副词后缀） + -y（形容词后缀）

worshipper.definitionCn: n. 礼拜者，敬拜者，拜神的人；崇拜者，仰慕者，爱慕者；<贬>盲目崇拜者，狂热崇拜者
englishDefinitions: a person who has religious faith；someone who admires too much to recognize faults
worshipper.formation: PIE root *wer- (2) "to turn, bend."；转动、弯曲 + -ship（身份、关系、技能或状态） + -er（比较级/施事名词后缀）

understatement.definitionCn: n. 保守的陈述；不充分的陈述；有保留的陈述
englishDefinitions: a statement that makes something seem less important, impressive, serious, etc. than it really is
understatement.formation: under-（在下、不足、未充分） + PIE *ndher- under；下方、在下面 + PIE root *sta- "to stand, make or be firm."；站立；使稳固 + -ment（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

disengage.definitionCn:
vt. 使脱离；解开；解除
vi. 脱出；松开
englishDefinitions: to free somebody/something from the person or thing that is holding them or it; to become free
to release or loosen from something that binds, unfasten
disengage.formation: Latin dis- "apart, asunder, in a different direction, between,"；分开、相反或朝不同方向 + *wadh- (1)-to pledge, to redeem a pledge；承诺、抵偿承诺

codify.definitionCn:
vt. 编纂；将...编成法典；编成法典
编纂/arrange (laws, rules) as a code; classify. We need to take the varying rules and regulations of the different health agencies and codify them into a national health code.
englishDefinitions: to reduce to a code
codify.formation: Latin caudex "book," literally "tree trunk,"；树 + -ify（使成为/变成后缀）

englishDefinitions: if an idea or feeling impels you to do something, you feel as if you are forced to do it
to urge a person, to press on, to incite to action or motion
impel.formation: PIE root *en "in"；在内、进入 + PIE *pel- (5)-to thrust, strike, drive；推、击、驱动

pragmatist.definitionCn: n. 实用主义者；爱管闲事的人
englishDefinitions: a person who behaves in a practical and sensible way rather than having fixed ideas or theories
practical person, realist
pragmatist.formation: Greek praktos "done; to be done,"；存在 + -ist（表示从事者、实施者或制造者的名词后缀）

bourgeois.definitionCn:
adj. 中产阶级的；世俗的；资产阶级的
n. 中产或资产阶级分子
n. (Bourgeois) （美、巴）布儒瓦（人名）
englishDefinitions: a person who belongs to the middle class
a member of the middle class
bourgeois.formation: PIE root *bhergh- (2) "high, elevated," with derivatives referring to hills and hill-forts；高

wistful.definitionCn: adj. 渴望的；沉思的，默想的；引起怀念的；不满足似的
englishDefinitions: thinking sadly about something that you would like to have, especially something in the past that you can no longer have
full of yearning or longing
wistful.formation: PIE *wen- (1)-to desire, strive for；渴望、努力争取 + /"full of, having, characterized by," also "amount or volume contained"；充满、具有……特征

exquisitely.definitionCn: adv. 精致地，精巧地；极其，异常，敏锐地（常与 sensitive、beautiful、attuned 等连用）
englishDefinitions: in a delicate manner
exquisitely.formation: PIE *eghs-out；向外、离开 + Latin quaere-to ask, inquire；询问、探究 + -ly（副词/形容词后缀）

stash.definitionCn:
n. 藏匿处；藏匿物
vt. 存放；贮藏
vi. 存放；藏起来
englishDefinitions: to store something in a safe or secret place
stash.formation: Latin cum "together, together with, in combination,"；一起、共同、结合 + PIE root *ag- to drive, draw out or forth, move；驱动、拉出、移动 + PIE root *sta- "to stand, make or be firm."；站立；使稳固

disclaim.definitionCn:
vt. 否认，拒绝；放弃，弃权；拒绝承认
vi. 否认；放弃；弃权
englishDefinitions: to state publicly that you have no knowledge of something, or that you are not responsible for something
to renounce all claim to, to deny responsibility for
disclaim.formation: Latin dis- "apart, asunder, in a different direction, between,"；分开、相反或朝不同方向 + Latin clamare-to cry out, shout, proclaim；呼喊 + PIE root *kele- (2) "to shout"；呼喊

englishDefinitions: a natural desire or need that makes you tend to do something, often something bad
natural or habitual inclination
proclivity.formation: PIE root *per- (1)-forward；向前、前进 + PIE root *klei- to lean；倾斜、倚靠

quirk.definitionCn:
n. 怪癖；急转；借口
n. (Quirk)人名；(英)夸克
englishDefinitions: an aspect of somebody’s personality or behaviour that is a little strange
something unusual about someone's manner or style
relating to the study of religion and beliefs
relating to the nature and will of god as revealed to humans
theological.formation: Greek theos-god；神 + -ical（与……有关的形容词后缀） + -logy（学科、研究或知识领域）

articulately.definitionCn:
发音清晰地
善于表达地
englishDefinitions: with eloquence；in an articulate manner
articulately.formation: Greek arthron "joint"；关节 + -ly（副词/形容词后缀）

scanty.definitionCn:
adj. 缺乏的；吝啬的；仅有的；稀疏的
缺乏的；稀疏的/meager; insufficient. Thinking his helping of food was scanty, Oliver Twist asked for more.
englishDefinitions: too little in amount for what is needed
scanty.formation: *skrink- to draw in the limbs, contract, shrivel up; wither, pine away；拉、画、在内、向上 + -y（名词/形容词构词后缀，依词源语境）

unrecognized.definitionCn: adj. 未被认出的，未被识别的；未被注意到的，未被察觉的；未被认可的，未受赏识的，未成名的；（会议、协议、政党等）未被承认的，未获正式承认的；（计算机/技术语境）无法识别的
englishDefinitions: not recognized；not having a secure reputation
unrecognized.formation: un-（否定前缀） + Latin re-（再、回） + Latin con-/com-（共同；recognize 中同化） + PIE root *gno-（知道、认识） + -ize（动词化后缀） + -ed（过去分词/形容词后缀）

well-travelled.definitionCn: adj. 经常旅行的；去过许多地方的
well-travelled.formation: PIE *wel-（愿望、意愿；well 副词“良好地”） + Vulgar Latin *tripaliare / Latin tripalium（与刑具、折磨有关；travel 的历史来源） + -ed（过去分词/形容词后缀）

logician.definitionCn: n. 逻辑学家；论理学者
englishDefinitions: a person who studies or has a lot of skill in logic
a person who studies or teaches logic
logician.formation: Greek lexis legein logos- to speak，word，reason；说

englishDefinitions: a worker engaged in making steel
steelworker.formation: PIE root *sta- "to stand, make or be firm."；站立；使稳固 + PIE root *werg- "to do"；做、从事

englishDefinitions: of, relating to, or characteristic of a reporter
reportorial.formation: Latin re-"again; back; anew, against."；再次、回返、重新；对抗 + PIE root *per- (2) "to lead, pass over."；引导、通过、越过 + -ial（形容词后缀）

reproducibility.definitionCn: n. 可重现性，可复制性；（计量学、统计学、实验科学）复现性，再现性
englishDefinitions: the quality of being reproducible
reproducibility.formation: Latin re-"again; back; anew, against."；再次、回返、重新；对抗 + PIE root *per- (1)-forward；向前、前进 + PIE root *deuk- "to lead"；引导、带领 + -ibility（性质名词后缀）

adaptiveness.definitionCn: n. 适应性，适应能力（adaptive 名词形式）
englishDefinitions: The quality of being adaptive; capacity to adapt.
adaptiveness.formation: PIE root *ad- "to, near, at."；向、到、靠近、在 + Latin aptus-fit, suited, proper, appropriate；使合适 + -ive（具有或倾向于某种性质的形容词后缀） + -ness（性质/状态名词后缀）

bellyful.definitionCn: n. 满腹，满肚子，一肚子；（非正式）过量，过多而令人受不了的量（have had a bellyful of sb/sth 表示对……受够了）
englishDefinitions: an undesirable overabundance
bellyful.formation: PIE root *bhel- (2) "to blow, swell"；吹、膨胀 + -ful（充满/具有…的后缀）

englishDefinitions: a Cox-2 inhibitor (trade name Celebrex) that relieves pain and inflammation without harming the digestive tract
celebrex.formation: Celebrex（Pfizer 药品品牌名；词源/造词过程未披露，不拆成词根）

commonplaceness.definitionCn: n. （通常不可数）平凡、普通、缺乏新意的性质或状态
englishDefinitions: ordinariness as a consequence of being frequent and commonplace
commonplaceness.formation: Latin locus（地方、位置） + Latin communis（共同的、普通的） + -ness（性质/状态名词后缀）

corruptive.definitionCn:
adj. 使堕落的；腐败性的；使腐坏的
腐败的
englishDefinitions: tending to corrupt or pervert
corruptive.formation: Latin cum "together, together with, in combination,"；一起、共同、结合 + PIE *runp- "to break"；打破 + -ive（形容词后缀）

econometric.definitionCn: adj. 计量经济学的，经济计量学的
englishDefinitions: of or relating to econometrics
econometric.formation: Greek oikos（“家、居所”） + Greek nomos（“管理、分配”） + -metric（-metry + -ic，测量/计量的）

meritocratic.definitionCn: adj. 精英管理的，贤能统治的，任人唯才的（指依据个人才能与成就，而非财富或社会地位，给予地位或奖励）。
englishDefinitions: relating to or characteristic of a meritocracy
meritocratic.formation: *(s)mer- (2)-to get a share of something；分得、获得一份 + -tic（形容词后缀） + -cracy（统治、政体）

englishDefinitions: One who lives in a province; a provincial.
provincialist.formation: PIE root *per- (1)-forward；向前、前进 + *weik- (3)-to fight, conquer；战斗、征服 + -ist（人物/从业者名词后缀）

shipload.definitionCn: n. 船货；船舶运载量，一船（人或货物）
englishDefinitions: the amount of cargo that can be held by a boat or ship or a freight car
shipload.formation: PIE root *sek- "to cut."；切、割 + PIE root *leit- (2) "to go forth"；去

englishDefinitions: to provide information or evidence to prove that something is true
to establish by proof or competent evidence
substantiate.formation: Latin preposition sub "under, below, beneath, at the foot of," also "close to, up to, towards;" of time, "within, during;" figuratively "subject to, in the power of;" also "a little, somewhat"；在下方 + PIE root *sta- "to stand, make or be firm."；站立；使稳固

englishDefinitions: to suggest that somebody/something is not important or valuable
to regard or represent as being of little worth
disparage.formation: Latin dis- "apart, asunder, in a different direction, between,"；分开、相反或朝不同方向 + Latin par-"equal, equal-sized, well-matched,"；相等、大小相同、相称

napoleonic.definitionCn: adj. （通常大写）拿破仑一世的；拿破仑一世时期的；拿破仑式的
englishDefinitions: of or relating to or like Napoleon Bonaparte

baseless.definitionCn: adj. 无根据的；无基础的
englishDefinitions: not supported by good reasons or facts
baseless.formation: Late Latin bassus "low, short"；低、矮、短 + -less（表示没有、缺乏的形容词后缀）

englishDefinitions: the act of stating something or of making it known, especially in an indirect way
the act of intimating, also, the thing intimated
intimation.formation: Latin intimus "inmost, innermost, deepest" + -ation（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

englishDefinitions: the act of killing another person, especially when it is a crime
homicide.formation: Latin homo-"man"；相同 + Latin -cida-cutter, killer, slayer；切割者；杀手、杀害者 + PIE root *kae-id- to strike；击打

chauvinistic.definitionCn: adj. 沙文主义的；盲目爱国的
englishDefinitions: showing an aggressive and unreasonable belief that your own country is better than all others
chauvinistic.formation: chauvinisme + -tic（形容词后缀） + -ic（与……有关的形容词后缀）

englishDefinitions: a person that you trust and who you talk to about private or secret things
a person in whom one can confide or share one's secrets
confidant.formation: Latin cum "together, together with, in combination,"；一起、共同、结合 + Latin fidere-to trust；信任 + PIE root *bheidh- "to trust, confide, persuade"；信任、相信；劝服

englishDefinitions: the state of being calm and in control of your feelings or behaviour
calmness of mind or matter, self-possession
composure.formation: Latin cum "together, together with, in combination,"；一起、共同、结合 + PIE root *tkei- "to settle, dwell, be home."；定居、居住 + -ure（动作、过程、结果或状态名词后缀）

fledge.definitionCn:
vi. 长羽毛
vt. 装上羽毛
磺ڣͻëexperienced practitionerоĴҵߣmaturityn.죩fledgevi.ëᣩmoltn./v.ë
englishDefinitions: to acquire the feathers necessary for flight or independent activity
to go beyond what is normal or allowed
overstep.formation: over-（在上、超过或过度） + PIE root *uper "over."；在上方、超过 + *stap- tread；踩踏

quasi.definitionCn:
adj. 准的；类似的；外表的
adv. 似是；有如
englishDefinitions: that appears to be something but is not really so
resembling or having a likeness to something
quasi.formation: Latin quasi-as if, as it were + PIE root *kwo-, stem of relative and interrogative pronouns.；疑问代词和关系代词的词干

eightfold.definitionCn:
adj. 八倍的；有八个部分的；八层的
adv. 八倍地；八重地；八层地
englishDefinitions: having eight units or members
eightfold.formation: Latin octo "eight,"；八 + PIE root *pel- (2) "to fold," hence "to turn."；折叠 + -fold（……倍的；表示倍数或数量）

englishDefinitions: the act of making immune (especially by inoculation)
immunization.formation: Latin immunis（“免除义务、豁免”） + -ation（构成动作/过程名词 immunization） + -ize（构成动词 immunize）

englishDefinitions: the probability of a specified outcome
likeliness.formation: like-like；像……的 + -ness（性质/状态名词后缀） + -ly（方式、程度或状态副词后缀；也可构成形容词）

englishDefinitions: anything that freshens
freshener.formation: Proto-Germanic *friskaz "fresh,"；新鲜的、清新的 + -er（比较级/施事名词后缀）

enslavement.definitionCn: n. 奴役，被奴役状态；束缚，难以摆脱的处境
englishDefinitions: the state of being a slave--Shakespeare；the act of making slaves of your captives
enslavement.formation: PIE root *en "in."；在内 + Latin Sclavus-slave；奴隶 + -ment（名词化后缀）

unhinge.definitionCn: vt. 使分开；取下……的铰链；使发狂或错乱
englishDefinitions: to make somebody seriously mentally ill
unhinge.formation: un-（不、非；反向、取消） + Old English un-prefix of negation；否定前缀，表示“不、非” + *konk- to hang；悬挂

upmarket.definitionCn:
adj. （主英国英语）高档的，质优价高的，高级的
adv. 向高档市场，在高档之列
n. 高档商品；高端市场类别
vt. 使进入高档消费市场
vi. 进入高档消费市场
englishDefinitions: designed for consumers with high incomes- New Yorker
upmarket.formation: up-（向上、增强） + Proto-Germanic *upp- "up"；向上 + Italic *merk- various aspects of economics；经济活动相关含义

furlough.definitionCn:
n. 休假；暂时解雇；放假
vt. 准假；暂时解雇
englishDefinitions: a leave of absence granted to a governmental or institutional employee (such as a soldier or civil servant)
a usually temporary layoff from work
furlough.formation: PIE root *leubh- "to care, desire, love."；关心、渴望、爱

remorseless.definitionCn: adj. 冷酷的；不知过错的；坚持不懈的；不屈不挠的
englishDefinitions: seeming to continue or become worse in a way that cannot be stopped
remorseless.formation: Latin re-"again; back; anew, against."；再次、回返、重新；对抗 + Latin mordēre-"to bite,"；咬 + -less（表示没有、缺乏的形容词后缀）

englishDefinitions: certain to be successful
sure-fire.formation: sure → Latin curare-to take care of + fire → Old English fir；火

wolverine.definitionCn: n. 狼獾，貂熊，豹熊；狼獾皮，貂熊裘；（首字母大写）金刚狼（漫威漫画角色，X战警成员）
englishDefinitions: a native or resident of Michigan；musteline mammal of northern Eurasia

anthropos.formation: Greek anthrōpos（“人、人类”；深层词源未定，传统的 anēr + ōps 拆分有争议）

bewilderingly.definitionCn: adv. 令人困惑地，使人迷乱地
englishDefinitions: in a bewildering and confusing manner
bewilderingly.formation: Old Englishbe- to make, cause；使、造成 + *welt- woodlands; wild；林地；野生的 + -ing（动名词或现在分词后缀） + -ly（副词/形容词后缀）

costless.definitionCn: adj. 不花钱的；无须付出代价的
englishDefinitions: costing nothing
costless.formation: coster + couster + couter + constare + con-；共同、一起；加强语气 + stare + -less（缺少…的后缀）

englishDefinitions: Free from passion; dispassionate.
dispassioned.formation: dis-（否定/相反） + passion（激情；Latin passio“承受、受苦”） + -ed（形容词后缀，表示具有/处于某种状态）

fluctuant.definitionCn: adj. 变动的，波动的，起伏的；（医学）波动性的，有波动感的
englishDefinitions: Moving like a wave; wavering；showing undulation or fluctuation; as, a fluctuant tumor.

headhunter.definitionCn: n. 猎头者，物色人才的人（尤指劝说候选人转任薪酬更高或职位更高工作的招聘者）；猎首者，旧时或某些部族习俗中猎取并保存敌人首级作为战利品的人
englishDefinitions: a recruiter of personnel (especially for corporations)；a savage who cuts off and preserves the heads of enemies as trophies
a second-rate prize fighter
palooka.formation: palooka（美国俚语词；来源不明，整体保留）

professionalise.definitionCn:
vt.使专业化；使职业化（professionalize 的英式拼写）
vi.专业化；职业化（professionalize 的英式拼写）
englishDefinitions: become professional or proceed in a professional manner or in an activity for pay or as a means of livelihood；make professional or give a professional character to
professionalise.formation: PIE root *per- (1)-forward；向前、前进 + Latin fari "to speak,"；说 + -ise（动词化后缀）

universalize.definitionCn: vt. 使普遍化，使一般化，普及
englishDefinitions: make universal
universalize.formation: PIE root *oi-no- "one, unique"；一、独一无二 + PIE root *wer- (2) "to turn, bend."；转动、弯曲 + -ize（动词化后缀）

unpatentable.definitionCn: adj. 不能取得专利的，不可授予专利的
unpatentable.formation: un-；不、非；反向、取消 + *pəter- father；父亲 + -able（可…的形容词后缀）

unreadiness.definitionCn: n. 未准备好，没预备，缺乏准备；不敏捷，迟疑，不机警
englishDefinitions: The quality or state of being unready.
unreadiness.formation: un-（不、非；反向、取消） + Old English un-prefix of negation；否定前缀，表示“不、非” + PIE root *reidh- to ride；骑行 + -ness（性质/状态名词后缀）

overtly.definitionCn: adv. 公开地，公然地，明显地
englishDefinitions: in an overt manner
overtly.formation: PIE root *apo- "off, away."；离开 + PIE root *wer- (4) "to cover."；覆盖 + -ly（副词/形容词后缀）

apprehensive.definitionCn:

n. 巡回者；行商
巡回的/wandering; traveling. He was an itinerant peddler and traveled through Pennsylvania and Virginia selling his wares. also  N.
englishDefinitions: travelling from place to place, especially to find work
itinerant.formation: Latin iterum-"again,"；再次 + PIE root *ei- to go；去

malevolent.definitionCn: adj. 恶毒的；有恶意的；坏心肠的
englishDefinitions: having or showing a desire to harm other people
having or displaying ill will, wishing harm on others
malevolent.formation: Latin malus (adj.) "bad, evil"；坏、邪恶 + PIE root *wel- (2) "to wish, will"；希望、意愿

quark.definitionCn: n. [高能][天] 夸克（理论上一种比原子更小的基本粒子）
englishDefinitions: any of several elementary particles that are postulated to come in pairs (as in the up and down varieties) of similar mass with one member having a charge of +⅔ and the other a charge of −⅓ and are held to make up hadrons
quark.formation: Old Church Slavonic tvarogu “curds, cottage cheese”（单一源词，未拆分） + PIE *teue- to swell；膨胀

riveting.definitionCn:
adj. 吸引人的
n. [机] 铆接
v. 用铆钉固定；集中于…（rivet的ing形式）

riveting.formation: *rei- to scratch, tear, cut；刮擦 + -ing（动名词或现在分词后缀）

transcendental.definitionCn: adj. 先验的；卓越的，[数] 超越的；超自然的
englishDefinitions: going beyond the usual limits of human knowledge, experience or reason, especially in a religious or spiritual way
transcendental.formation: Latin trans (prep.) "across, over, beyond,"；横过、越过、超出 + PIE *skand- to spring, leap, climb；跳起、跃升、攀登 + -al（与……有关的形容词后缀）

englishDefinitions: a short phrase that says something true or wise

aphorism.formation: apo- of, from, away from; separate, apart from, free from；来自、离开；分开、脱离 + Greek horos "boundary, limit, border"；边界 + -ism（表示主义、体系、学说或做法的名词后缀）

belligerence.definitionCn: n. 斗争性；好战性；交战
englishDefinitions: unfriendly and aggressive feelings or behaviour
belligerence.formation: Latin bellum-war；战争 + gerere-to bear, carry, bring forth + -ence（动作、状态或性质名词后缀）

despot.definitionCn:
n. 专制君主，暴君；独裁者

guillotine.definitionCn:
n. 断头台；切纸机；截止辩论以付表决法

illegality.definitionCn: n. 违法；[法] 非法行为；犯规

illegality.formation: il-（不、非） + PIE root *ne- "not"；不、非 + Latin lex-law；法律 + -ity（性质/状态抽象名词后缀）

nadir.definitionCn:

capitulate.definitionCn: vi. 认输，屈服；屈从，停止反抗；有条件投降；让步

captious.definitionCn: adj. 挑剔的；吹毛求疵的

inconsiderable.definitionCn: adj. 不足取的；不值得考虑的；琐屑的

v. 改变；使发酵；影响；使……较有趣；为……增色
englishDefinitions: to make bread rise by adding a substance, especially yeast
to add a leavening agent
leaven.formation: Latin levare-"to raise"；举起 + PIE root *legwh- not heavy, having little weight；少量 + -en（使成为……的动词后缀）

ornithologist.definitionCn:
n. 鸟类学家，鸟类学者
鸟类学家/scientific student of birds. Audubon's drawings of American bird life have been of interest not only to the ornithologists but also to the general public.
englishDefinitions: a person who studies birds
ornithologist.formation: Greek ornis "a bird,"；鸟 + -ist（表示从事者、实施者或制造者的名词后缀） + -logy（学科、研究或知识领域）

divisor.definitionCn:
n. 除数；因子
因子，除数
englishDefinitions: the number by which a dividend is divided
a number or expression that another is to be divided by

elongate.definitionCn:
vt. 拉长；使延长；使伸长
vi. 拉长；延长；伸长
adj. 伸长的；延长的
englishDefinitions: to become longer; to make something longer

intersperse.definitionCn: v. 散布，散置；点缀；在……中夹杂某物
englishDefinitions: to put something in something else or among or between other things
to mix irregularly something with something else
intersperse.formation: Latin inter (prep., adv.) "among, between, betwixt, in the midst of"；在……之间 + PIE root *sper- "to spread, to sow"；铺开、播种

unruly.definitionCn:
adj. 不守规矩的；任性的；难驾驭的
不服从的；倔强的/disobedient; lawless. The only way to curb this unruly mob is to use tear gas.
adj. 不守规矩的；任性的；难驾驭的
不服从的；倔强的/disobedient; lawless. The only way to curb this unruly mob is to use tear gas.
englishDefinitions: difficult to control or manage

flippant.definitionCn: adj. 轻率的；嘴碎的；没礼貌的
englishDefinitions: showing that you do not take something as seriously as other people think you should
frivolously disrespectful, shallow or lacking in seriousness
flippant.formation: Old Norse flaka-to flicker, flutter, hang losse；闪烁、拍动、悬挂松垂

parenthetical.definitionCn: adj. 插句的；附加说明的；放在括号里的
englishDefinitions: given as extra information in a speech or piece of writing
parenthetical.formation: Greek para- from para (prep.) "beside, near; issuing from; against, contrary to"；再次 + PIE root *dhe- to set, put；放置、安放 + -ical（形容词后缀） + -al（形容词后缀）

retrograde.definitionCn:
adj. 倒退的；退化的；次序颠倒的
vi. 逆行；倒退；退步
vt. 使倒退
adv. 倒退地；向后地
englishDefinitions: making a situation worse or returning to how something was in the past
to move backwards, to recede
retrograde.formation: Latin retro (prep.) "backward, back, behind,"；在后 + PIE root *ghredh- to walk, go；行走、前往

thereof.definitionCn: adv. 它的；由此；在其中；关于…；将它
englishDefinitions: of the thing mentioned

luminosity.definitionCn: n. [光][天] 光度；光明；光辉
englishDefinitions: the fact of shining in the dark; the ability to give out light
luminosity.formation: PIE root *leuk- light, brightness；光、明亮 + -ity（性质/状态抽象名词后缀）

playfulness.definitionCn: n. 玩兴，爱玩闹的性情；嬉闹；玩笑
englishDefinitions: a festive merry feeling；a disposition to find (or make) causes for amusement
playfulness.formation: PIE root *dlegh- "to engage oneself, be or become fixed,"；投入、固定 + /"full of, having, characterized by," also "amount or volume contained"；充满、具有……特征 + -ful（充满、具有……的形容词后缀） + -ness（性质/状态名词后缀）

factorization.definitionCn:
n. （数学）把一个整数或多项式分解为几个因子相乘的形式（因子分解，因式分解）
因式分解
englishDefinitions: (mathematics) the resolution of an entity into factors such that when multiplied together they give the original entity
factorization.formation: Latin facere "to make, to do"；做、制作 + -ization（名词化后缀） + -ation（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

outcrop.definitionCn:
n. 露头；露出地面的岩层
vi. 露出
englishDefinitions: a large mass of rock that stands above the surface of the ground
outcrop.formation: out-；向外、超过、完全 + crop + croppe + cropp + krop + kropf + kroppr

babble.definitionCn:
v. 含糊不清地说；喋喋不休；（不自觉或不小心）泄露机密；（水流过石块）潺潺作响
n. 嘈杂的人声；含糊不清的话；胡言乱语；行话；（水流的）潺潺声；（幼儿）咿呀学语声；电信（集扰）
嘟囔/chatter idly. The little girl babbled about her doll. also  N.
englishDefinitions: talking that is confused or silly and is difficult to understand
babble.formation: PIE root *barbar- echoic of unintelligible speech of foreigners；模仿外国人难懂言语的拟声词

foreboding.definitionCn:
n. 预感；先兆；预兆
adj. 预感的；不祥之兆的
不详的预感/premonition of evil. Suspecting no conspiracies against him, Caesar gently ridiculed his wife's forebodings about the Ides of March.
englishDefinitions: a strong feeling that something unpleasant or dangerous is going to happen
foreboding.formation: fore-（在前、预先） + PIE root *per- (1)-forward；向前、前进 + PIE root *bheudh- "be aware, make aware."；察觉、使意识到 + -ing（动名词或现在分词后缀）

predispose.definitionCn: vt. 预先处置；使…偏向于
englishDefinitions: to influence somebody so that they are likely to think or behave in a particular way
to make someone susceptible to something (such as a disease)
predispose.formation: pre-（在……之前、预先） + PIE root *per- (1)-forward；向前、前进 + Latin dis- "apart, asunder, in a different direction, between,"；分开、相反或朝不同方向 + PIE root *tkei- "to settle, dwell, be home."；定居、居住

unoriginal.definitionCn: adj. 非原先的，非独创的；模仿的
englishDefinitions: lacking originality : not original
unoriginal.formation: un-（不、非；反向、取消） + Old English un-prefix of negation；否定前缀，表示“不、非” + Latin oriri-appear, be born, arise；出现、出生、升起

englishDefinitions: An archbishop is a bishop of the highest rank, in charge of all the churches in a large region.
a senior bishop who is in charge of an archdiocese
archbishop.formation: Greek arkhein "be the first," thence "to begin, begin from or with, make preparation for;"；第一 + Greek epi- "over"；在上方、超过 + Greek skopos-"one that watches, one that looks after; a guardian, protector"；保护

flightless.definitionCn: adj. （鸟、昆虫等）不能飞的，不会飞的
englishDefinitions: incapable of flying

hatchling.definitionCn: n. 刚孵化的小动物，幼雏
englishDefinitions: any recently hatched animal (especially birds)
hatchling.formation: Latin cubare-to lie down；躺、向下 + -ling（名词后缀，指幼体/小者）

englishDefinitions: unhappy, in a bad mood and not talking very much
gloomily or sullenly ill-humored, as a person or mood
morose.formation: Latin mos-one's disposition, in plural, mores, customs, manners, morals；方式

englishDefinitions: of or relating to paleontology
paleontological.formation: Greek palaios "old, ancient"；古老 + Greek on (genitive ontos) "being," + -ical（形容词后缀） + -logy（学科、研究或知识领域）

polygon.definitionCn:
n. 多边形；多角形物体
多边形
englishDefinitions: a closed plane figure bounded by straight lines
a figure having three or more sides
polygon.formation: Greek polys "many"；多、许多 + PIE root *genu- (1) "knee; angle."；膝；角 + PIE root *pele- (1)-to fill-abundance and multitude；填满；丰富、众多

unobtrusive.definitionCn: adj. 不唐突的；谦虚的；不引人注目的
englishDefinitions: not attracting unnecessary attention
not noticeable or blatant, inconspicuous
unobtrusive.formation: un-（不、非；反向、取消） + Old English un-prefix of negation；否定前缀，表示“不、非” + ob- toward; against; before; near; across; down,；朝向、对着；在前、附近、横过或向下 + PIE *treud- to press, push, squeeze；按压

deface.definitionCn: v. 损伤外观，丑化，毁坏
englishDefinitions: to damage the appearance of something especially by drawing or writing on it
to damage something in a visible or conspicuous manner
deface.formation: Latin de "down, down from, from, off; concerning"；向下、离开；关于 + Latin facies-"appearance, form, figure," and secondarily "visage, countenance,"；外观

ineptitude.definitionCn: n. 不适当，不合适；不称职；愚笨；缺乏技巧，无能；笨拙
englishDefinitions:
Lack of skill or judgement; clumsy incompetence or foolish behaviour.
释义：lack of skill
ineptitude.formation: PIE root *ne- "not"；不、非 + Latin aptus-fit, suited, proper, appropriate；使合适

outwit.definitionCn:
vt. 瞒骗；以智取胜
欺骗；瞒骗/outsmart; trick. By disguising himself as an old woman, Holmes was able to outwit his pursuers and escape capture.
vt. 瞒骗；以智取胜
欺骗；瞒骗/outsmart; trick. By disguising himself as an old woman, Holmes was able to outwit his pursuers and escape capture.
englishDefinitions: to defeat somebody/something or gain an advantage over them by doing something clever
outwit.formation: out-（向外、超过、胜过） + Old English ut "out, without, outside,"；外面、向外、没有 + PIE root *weid- "to see" (hence "to know")；看见

phenology.definitionCn: n. 物候学，生物气候学；物候现象
englishDefinitions: The science of the relations between climate and periodic biological phenomena, as the migrations and breeding of birds, the flowering and fruiting of plants, etc.

fairground.definitionCn: n. 露天市场；举行赛会的场所；游乐场
englishDefinitions: a place where a fair
fairground.formation: Latin festa-holidays, feasts, festal banquets；节日、宴会、庆典宴席 + ground；地面、土地

englishDefinitions: an idea that is intended to bring political or social improvement, but will probably not succeed
a medicine sold with false claims and no demonstrable value
nostrum.formation: PIE *nes- (2), forming oblique cases of the first person plural personal pronoun；构成 + Latin re-"again; back; anew, against."；再次、回返、重新；对抗 + Latin mederi-"to heal"；治愈、治疗

parallelogram.definitionCn:
n. 平行四边形
平行四边形
englishDefinitions: a quadrilateral with opposite sides parallel and equal
parallelogram.formation: Greek para- from para (prep.) "beside, near; issuing from; against, contrary to"；再次 + Latin alter-the other (of the two)；另一个、两者中的另一个 + Greek graphein-"to draw or write"；画、写

proctor.definitionCn:
n. 代理人；学监；监考员
vt. 监督
englishDefinitions: someone who supervises or monitors students
to supervise or monitor
proctor.formation: PIE root *per- (1)-forward；向前、前进 + Latin curare-to take care of；拿取

unsanitary.definitionCn: adj. 不卫生的；有碍健康的
englishDefinitions: dirty and likely to spread disease
unsanitary.formation: un-（不、非；反向、取消） + Old English un-prefix of negation；否定前缀，表示“不、非” + Latin sanus "sound, healthy,"；声音

englishDefinitions: a word (such as NATO, radar, or laser) formed from the initial letter or letters of each of the successive parts or major parts of a compound term
acronym.formation: Greek akros-at the end, at the top, outermost; consummate, excellent；在、末端、顶部 + PIE root *no-men- "name"；名称 + -onym "name"；名称

consternation.definitionCn: n. 惊愕；惊惶失措；恐怖
englishDefinitions: a worried, sad feeling after you have received an unpleasant surprise
feelings of anxiety or dismay
consternation.formation: Latin cum "together, together with, in combination,"；一起、共同、结合 + Greek aster-star；星星 + PIE *stere-（铺展） + -ation（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

entrap.definitionCn: vt. 使陷入；使陷罗网；欺骗
englishDefinitions: to put or catch somebody/something in a place or situation from which they cannot escape
entrap.formation: en-（进入、使处于……状态） + Latin in- "in, into"；不、非；进入、向内 + PIE *der- (1)-to run, walk, step；跑

gruesome.definitionCn:
adj. 可怕的；阴森的
可怕的/grisly; horrible. His face was the stuff of nightmares: all the children in the audience screamed when Freddy Kruger's gruesome countenance was flashed on the screen.
englishDefinitions: very unpleasant and filling you with horror, usually because it is related to death or injury
gruesome.formation: PIE root *kreue- "raw flesh"；生肉 + /-some (1)-"tending to; causing; to a considerable degree,"；倾向于、导致；在相当程度上

englishDefinitions: believing strongly in a particular religion and obeying its laws and practices
devoted to religion or to religious feelings and duties
devout.formation: Latin de "down, down from, from, off; concerning"；向下、离开；关于 + *wegwh- to speak solemnly, vow, preach；说

jocular.definitionCn: adj. 爱开玩笑的；打趣的；滑稽的
englishDefinitions: enjoying making people laugh
characterized by, or intended for joking or jesting
jocular.formation: Latin iocus-"joke, jest, sport, pastime"；玩笑、戏谑、娱乐

nefarious.definitionCn: adj. 邪恶的；穷凶极恶的；不法的
englishDefinitions: (of actions or people) criminal or morally very bad.
extremely wicked or villainous, iniquitous
nefarious.formation: PIE root *ne- "not"；不、非 + Latin fabula-a tale；故事、寓言 + PIE root *bha- (2)-to speak, tell, say；说、讲、告诉

englishDefinitions: a statement saying that something you previously said or wrote is not true
withdrawal of a statement, opinion, promise, etc
retraction.formation: Latin re-"again; back; anew, against."；再次、回返、重新；对抗 + *tragh- to draw, drag, move；拉、拖、移动 + -tion（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

asymmetrical.definitionCn: adj. 非对称的；不匀称的，不对等的
englishDefinitions: having two sides or halves that are not the same : not symmetrical
asymmetrical.formation: Greek a-, an- "not"；在、向、处于某种状态；依词源语境 + PIE root *me- (2) "to measure."；测量 + -ical（形容词后缀，表示“与……有关的”）

ethnography.definitionCn: n. 民族志；人种志；人种学
englishDefinitions: the study and systematic recording of human cultures
ethnography.formation: Greek ethnos-people, nation, class, caste, tribe; a number of people accustomed to live together；一起 + Greek graphein-"to draw or write"；画、写 + -graphy（书写、记录、描绘；构成学科/过程名词）

mid-century.formation: PIE root *medhyo- "middle"；中间 + Latin centum "one hundred"；一

mimicry.definitionCn:
n. 模仿，模拟；（动物等）拟态伪装
模仿/imitation. Her gift for mimicry was so great that her friends said that she should be in the theater.
englishDefinitions: the action of copying or the skill of being able to copy the voice, movements, etc. of others
mimicry.formation: PIE root *aim- "to copy"；模仿、复制 + -ry（活动、技艺、场所或集合名词后缀）

englishDefinitions: a minute or minor detail
a minor detail, often of negligible importance
minutia.formation: Latin minus, minor "less," hence "subordinate"；较少；次要、从属 + PIE root *mei- (2)-small；小、微小

englishDefinitions: communication from one mind to another by extrasensory means
the capability to communicate directly by psychic means
telepathy.formation: Greek tele-"far off, afar, at or to a distance,"；远距离 + Latin passivus-capable of feeling or suffering；能够感受或承受的 + -pathy（疾病/感受/治疗领域，依词源语境）

cacophony.definitionCn: n. 刺耳的音调；不和谐音
englishDefinitions: harsh or jarring sound : dissonance
a harsh, discordant mixture of sounds
cacophony.formation: PIE root *kakka- "to defecate."；排便 + PIE root *bha- (2)-to speak, tell, say；说、讲、告诉

englishDefinitions: to remove caffeine from
decaffeinate.formation: de-（去除/反向前缀） + caffeine + -ate（动词化后缀）

genial.definitionCn: adj. 亲切的，友好的；和蔼的；适宜的
englishDefinitions: friendly and cheerful
warmly and pleasantly cheerful, cordial
genial.formation: PIE root *gene- "give birth, beget,"；生育、产生 + -al（与……有关的形容词后缀）

grudging.definitionCn:
adj. 勉强的；吝啬的
不情愿；勉强/unwilling; reluctant; stingy. We received only grudging support from the mayor despite his earlier promises of aid.
englishDefinitions: given or done unwillingly
grudging.formation: PIE *ghremno- angry；愤怒的 + PIE echoic base *reu- "to roar, make hoarse cries"；咆哮、发出嘶哑叫声 + -ing（动名词或现在分词后缀）

hexagon.definitionCn:
n. 六角形，六边形
adj. 成六角的；成六边的
六边形
englishDefinitions: a polygon of six angles and six sides
a polygon with six sides and six angles
hexagon.formation: Greek hex-"six,"；六 + PIE root *genu- (1) "knee; angle."；膝；角

indigent.definitionCn: adj. 贫困的；贫穷的（副词indigently）
englishDefinitions: not having any money or possessions
lacking food, clothing, etc because of poverty
indigent.formation: PIE root *en "in"；在内、进入 + Latin egere-be in need, want；在内、想要

padding.definitionCn:
n. 填料；垫料
v. 填补（pad的ing形式）
englishDefinitions: soft material that is placed inside something to make it more comfortable or to change its shape
padding.formation: *pent- to go, tread；去 + -ing（动名词或现在分词后缀）

titular.definitionCn:
adj. 有名无实的；有头衔的；标题的
n. 有称号或头衔的人；只有名义的人
有名无实的/nominal holding of title without obligations. Although he was the titular head of the company, the real decisions were made by his general manager.
englishDefinitions: having a particular title or status but no real power or authority
titular.formation: Latin titulus-"inscription, label, ticket, placard, heading; honorable appellation, title of honor,"；荣誉 + -ar（形容词后缀，表示“与……有关的”）

untried.definitionCn: adj. 未经实验的；未经审讯的；未经检查的
englishDefinitions: not yet tried or tested to discover if it works or is successful
untried.formation: un-（不、非；反向、取消） + Old English un-prefix of negation；否定前缀，表示“不、非” + *triare-try；尝试

well-funded.formation: PIE root *wel- (2) "to wish, will"；希望、意愿 + *bhudh- bottom, base；底部、基础 + -ed（过去式/过去分词后缀）

anchovy.definitionCn: n. 鳀鱼，凤尾鱼（鳀科小型海鱼的统称）；（食品）常经盐腌、油浸或制成罐头、鱼酱等，用作开胃菜或调味配料
englishDefinitions: tiny fishes usually canned or salted; used for hors d'oeuvres or as seasoning in sauces；small herring-like plankton-eating fishes often canned whole or as paste; abundant in tropical waters worldwide

attested.definitionCn: adj. 证明无病的；经检验证明无病的；经检验证明无菌的
englishDefinitions: to affirm to be true or genuine
attested.formation: Latin testis-witness；见证；证人 + -ed（过去式或过去分词后缀）

chronicler.definitionCn: n. 记录者；编年史作者，年代史编者
englishDefinitions: someone who writes chronicles
chronicler.formation: Greek khronos-time, a defined time, a lifetime, a season, a while；时间 + -er（比较级/施事名词后缀）

dabble.definitionCn:
vt. 溅湿；浸入水中
vi. 涉猎；涉足；玩水
englishDefinitions: to take part in a sport, an activity, etc. but not very seriously
to work at anything in an irregular or superficial manner

deacon.definitionCn:
n. 执事；助祭
vt. 朗读；搞欺骗
n. (Deacon)人名；(英)迪肯
englishDefinitions: a subordinate officer in a Christian church: such as
a member of the clerical order below that of a priest
deacon.formation: Greek dia-through; throughout；穿过、横跨 + PIE *ken- "to hasten, set oneself in motion."；自己

garish.definitionCn: adj. 炫耀的；过分装饰的；过分鲜艳的
englishDefinitions: very brightly coloured in an unpleasant way
overly ostentatious, so colourful as to be in bad taste
garish.formation: *gau- to rejoice；欢喜、欣喜 + -ish（形容词后缀，表示“有……特征的/略带……”）

inflection.definitionCn: n. 弯曲，变形；音调变化
englishDefinitions: a change in how high or low your voice is as you are speaking
inflection.formation: PIE root *en "in"；在内、进入 + Latin flectere "to bend"；弯曲 + -tion（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

parapsychology.definitionCn: n. [心理] 心灵学；超心理学；通灵学（以传心术、千里眼等超自然现象为研究对象）
englishDefinitions: a field of study concerned with the investigation of evidence for paranormal psychological phenomena (such as telepathy, clairvoyance, and psychokinesis)
parapsychology.formation: Greek para- from para (prep.) "beside, near; issuing from; against, contrary to"；再次 + Greek psykhē-"mind, life, soul"；生命 + -logy（学科、研究或知识领域）

primordial.definitionCn: adj. 原始的；根本的；原生的
englishDefinitions: Primordial means existing from the very beginning of time, or from the earliest stages of development; very basic and fundamental.
first, earliest or original
primordial.formation: Latin primus-"first, the first, first part," figuratively "chief, principal; excellent, distinguished, noble"；第一 + Proto-Italic *ordn- "row, order"；行、次序

strenuously.definitionCn: adv. 费力地，刻苦地，勤奋地；（多修饰表示反对、否认、坚持、辩护的动词）极力地，坚决地
englishDefinitions: in a strenuous manner; strongly or vigorously
strenuously.formation: PIE root *strig- to stroke, rub, press；抚、擦、按压 + -ly（副词/形容词后缀）

amalgamate.definitionCn:
vi. 合并；汞齐化；调制汞合金
vt. 合并；使（金属）汞齐化；混合

ingratiating.formation: PIE root *ne- "not"；不、非 + PIE root *gwere- (2)-to favor；偏爱、支持 + -ing（动名词或现在分词后缀）

invocation.definitionCn: n. （向神或权威人士的）求助，祈祷；咒语；（仪式或集会开始时的）发言，祷文；（法院对另案的）文件调取；（计算机）调用，启用；（法权的）行使
englishDefinitions: the act or process of petitioning for help or support
the act of calling for the presence of some superior being
invocation.formation: PIE root *en "in"；在内、进入 + Latin vox-voice；声音、嗓音 + -ation（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

irradiance.definitionCn: n. [核] 辐照度；发光；光辉
englishDefinitions: a measurement of the amount of light that comes from something
incident flux of radiant energy per unit area
irradiance.formation: ir-（不、非） + PIE root *en "in."；在内 + Latin radius-"staff, stake, rod; spoke of a wheel; ray of light, beam of light; radius of a circle,"；圆

left-right.definitionCn: 极左极右：用来指代政治团体观点极端的术语。
left-right.formation: *laiwo- left；左、左边 + PIE root *reg- "move in a straight line," with derivatives meaning "to direct in a straight line," thus "to lead, rule."；直行；引导、统治

mesmerize.definitionCn: vt. 施催眠术；迷住；以魅力迫使
englishDefinitions: to have such a strong effect on you that you cannot give your attention to anything else
to exercise mesmerism on, to spellbind, to enthrall
a figure of speech consisting of the use of the name of one thing for that of another of which it is an attribute or with which it is associated (such as "crown" in "lands belonging to the crown")
figure of speech: an object's name used for a related object
the quality of not being severe or strong
mildness.formation: PIE root *mel- (1) "soft"；柔软 + -ness（性质或状态名词后缀）

missive.definitionCn:
n. 公文， 公函；信件，信函
adj. 送出的
englishDefinitions: a written communication : letter
a written message, a letter, note or memo
missive.formation: Latin mittere-to release, let go; send, throw; to put, place；释放、发送、投掷、放置 + -ive（具有或倾向于某种性质的形容词后缀）

noncommittal.definitionCn: adj. 态度不明朗的；不承担义务的；无明确意义的
englishDefinitions: giving no clear indication of attitude or feeling
reluctant to give out information or show one's opinion
noncommittal.formation: non-（不、非） + Old Latin noenum "not one"；不、非、一 + Latin cum "together, together with, in combination,"；一起、共同、结合 + Latin mittere-to release, let go; send, throw; to put, place；释放、发送、投掷、放置

opalescent.definitionCn:
adj. 乳白色的；发乳白光的
乳白的/iridescent; lustrous. The oil slick on the water had an opalescent, rainbow-like sheen.
englishDefinitions: changing colour like an opal
opalescent.formation: Sanskrit upala-s-gem, precious stone；石头 + -escent（逐渐呈现某性质的；构成形容词）

ostracize.definitionCn: vt. 放逐；排斥；按贝壳流放法放逐
englishDefinitions: to refuse to let somebody be a member of a social group; to refuse to meet or talk to somebody
to exclude (a person) from society or from a community

outdistance.definitionCn: vt. 超越，大大超过；把……抛在后面
englishDefinitions: to leave somebody/something behind by going faster, further, etc.; to be better than somebody/something
outdistance.formation: out-（向外、超过、胜过） + di-（分开、二） + Old English ut "out, without, outside,"；外面、向外、没有 + dis-apart, away；分开、相反、否定 + PIE root *sta- "to stand, make or be firm."；站立；使稳固

preamble.definitionCn:
n. （法规、契约的）序言，绪论；前言，开场白
v. 作序文
englishDefinitions: an introduction to a book or a written document; an introduction to something you say
an introductory statement
preamble.formation: pre-（在……之前、预先） + PIE root *per- (1)-forward；向前、前进 + PIE root *el- to go；去

profiteer.definitionCn:
v. 牟取暴利，投机
n. （贸易）奸商，牟取暴利者
englishDefinitions: a person who makes a lot of money in an unfair way, for example by asking very high prices for things that are hard to get
a person who seeks exorbitant profits
profiteer.formation: PIE root *per- (1)-forward；向前、前进 + PIE root *dhe- to set, put；放置、安放 + /eer-noun word-forming element meaning "one who" (operates, produces, deals in)；一、……的人

pucker.definitionCn:
vt. 折叠；使起皱；使缩拢
vi. 折叠；皱起；缩拢
n. 皱纹；皱褶
n. (Pucker)人名；(德)普克
englishDefinitions: to form or to make something form small folds or lines
pucker.formation: PIE root *bhel- (2) "to blow, swell"；吹、膨胀 + -er（施事者或比较级后缀）

englishDefinitions: to repair a machine so that it is in good condition and works well
recondition.formation: Latin re-"again; back; anew, against."；再次、回返、重新；对抗 + Latin cum "together, together with, in combination,"；一起、共同、结合 + PIE root *dhe- to set, put；放置、安放 + -ition（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

remediable.definitionCn: adj. 可治疗的；可矫正的；可补救的
englishDefinitions: that can be solved or cured
capable of being fixed
remediable.formation: Latin re-"again; back; anew, against."；再次、回返、重新；对抗 + Latin mederi-"to heal"；治愈、治疗

englishDefinitions: an earnest presentation of reasons for opposition or grievance
a protest
remonstrance.formation: Latin re-"again; back; anew, against."；再次、回返、重新；对抗 + Latin monere-"to remind, bring to (one's) recollection, tell (of); admonish, advise, warn, instruct, teach,"；收集

englishDefinitions: a job which you get paid for even though you do not have to do very much
a job that requires no work but still gives an ample payment
sinecure.formation: Latin sed- "without, apart, aside,"；没有 + Latin curare-to take care of；拿取

sinuosity.definitionCn: n. 弯曲；弯曲处；错综复杂；曲折度
englishDefinitions: the quality or state of being sinuous
a curve, bend or turn
sinuosity.formation: Latin sinus-a curve, winding + -ity（性质/状态抽象名词后缀）

spelunker.definitionCn: n. 探勘洞穴者；地下冒险
englishDefinitions: one who makes a hobby of exploring and studying caves
one who explores caves, one who spelunks
a little sphere or spherical body
spherule.formation: Greek sphaira "globe, ball, playing ball, terrestrial globe,"；球体、球；地球仪

englishDefinitions: the act of persuading somebody to do something, as opposed to using force
the act of urging or influencing, persuasion
suasion.formation: Latin suadere-"to urge, incite, promote, advise, persuade," literally "recommend as good"；劝服 + suadere（Latin“劝告、劝说”；PIE *swād-“甜、愉悦”） + -sion（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

trespass.definitionCn:
v. 非法侵入（他人的土地或财产）；做错事；违反道德（或社会法规）
n. （对他人土地或财产的）非法侵入；罪过；妨碍，冒犯
过失；侵入/unlawfully enter the boundaries of some else's property. The wicked baron flogged any poacher who trespassed on his private hunting grounds. also  N.
englishDefinitions: to enter land or a building that you do not have permission or the right to enter
trespass.formation: Latin trans "across, over, beyond,"；横过 + *pete- to spread；铺开

trestle.definitionCn: n. [交] 栈桥，高架桥；支架，搁凳
englishDefinitions: a braced frame serving as a support
a frame with a horizontal beam supported by a pair of legs

unscrew.definitionCn: v. 旋开，旋松，拧开（瓶盖、螺帽等旋转部件）；也可指（瓶盖、螺帽等）经拧动后松开；旋出螺丝卸下（用螺丝固定的物件），从……旋出螺丝
englishDefinitions: loosen something by unscrewing it；loosen by turning
unscrew.formation: un-（否定前缀） + PIE root *sek- "to cut."；切、割

unstinting.definitionCn:
adj. 慷慨的；大方的；无限制的
慷慨的；无保留的/giving generously; not holding back. The dean praised the donor of the new science building for her unstinting generosity.
englishDefinitions: given or giving generously
unstinting.formation: Old English un-prefix of negation；否定前缀，表示“不、非” + *stuntaz-short, truncated；短

white-faced.definitionCn: adj. 前额有白斑的；面容苍白的
white-faced.formation: *kweit- white; to shine；发光 + Latin facies-"appearance, form, figure," and secondarily "visage, countenance,"；外观 + -ed（过去式/过去分词后缀）

action-comedy.definitionCn: n．动作喜剧：一种电影或戏剧类型，结合了动作和喜剧元素，通常包含激烈的打斗场面和幽默对白。
action-comedy.formation: Latin agere "to set in motion, drive, drive forward; to do, perform"；执行 + 神话人名 + Greek kōmos-revel, carousal, merry-making, festival"；狂欢、宴饮、庆祝、节日 + Greek aude-voice, tone, sound；声音 + -tion（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

englishDefinitions: a flat bread made of oat or barley flour; common in New England and Scotland
of or relating to or containing basalt

beauteous.definitionCn: adj. （文学用语）美丽的，优美的，美妙的
englishDefinitions: (poetic )beautiful, especially to the sight
beauteous.formation: Latin beatus-blessed, happy；受祝福的、幸福的 + -ous（形容词后缀）

broken-wing.definitionCn: 受伤的翅膀：指鸟类的翅膀受伤或残疾，也可比喻人因某种原因而失去了能力或自由。
broken-wing.formation: PIE root *bhreg- "to break"；打破、折断 + PIE root *we- "to blow"；吹 + -en（使成为……的动词后缀）

englishDefinitions: nightingale spoken of in Persian poetry
having a granular structure like that of chondrites
chondritic.formation: Greek chondros（“谷粒、软骨”） + chondrite（球粒陨石） + -ic（形容词后缀）

chrysanthemum-flower.formation: Greek chryso- gold, gold-colored；黄金 + PIE root *andh- to bloom；开花 + Latin florem "flower"；花 + -er（施事者或比较级后缀）

clutch-size.definitionCn: 产卵数量：一次繁殖中一个雌性动物所产下的卵的数量。
clutch-size.formation: clutch → Old English cloche + size → PIE root *sed- (1) "to sit."；坐

englishDefinitions: An advocate of communalism.
communalist.formation: French communaliste + -al（与……有关的形容词后缀） + -ist（表示从事者、实施者或制造者的名词后缀）

computer-animated.formation: Latin cum "together, together with, in combination,"；一起、共同、结合 + Latin putare-to judge, suppose, believe, suspect，originally "to clean, trim, prune"；判断、认为、相信；原义为清洁、修整、修剪 + PIE root *ane- to breathe；呼吸 + -er（施事者或比较级后缀） + -ed（过去式或过去分词后缀）

englishDefinitions: the act of stating officially in a religious ceremony that something is holy and can be used for religious purposes
consecration.formation: Latin cum "together, together with, in combination,"；一起、共同、结合 + PIE root *shnk- "to make sacred, sanctify,"；制作 + -ation（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

cross-generational.formation: Latin crux-cross；交叉、十字 + PIE root *gene- "give birth, beget,"；生育、产生 + -ation（动作、过程或结果名词后缀） + -al（形容词后缀）

englishDefinitions: the act or process of effacing or eliminating something
effacement.formation: Latin facies-"appearance, form, figure," and secondarily "visage, countenance,"；外观 + -ment（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

encaustic.definitionCn:
adj. 烧上蜡的；上釉烧的
n. 蜡画法；蜡画
englishDefinitions: a paint made from pigment mixed with melted beeswax and resin and after application fixed by heat
encaustic.formation: en-（使成为前缀） + Greek kaiein-burn；燃烧

englishDefinitions: a diminutive flower (especially one that is part of a composite flower)
floweret.formation: flower（花；古法语 flor / 拉丁语 flos） + -et（小称后缀，表示“小的”）

hook-and-eye.definitionCn: 钩眼：一种由两部分组成的紧固装置，通常用于衣物或门上，由一个金属钩子和一个横杆或环组成，钩子可以抓住横杆或插入环中。
hook-and-eye.formation: hook → *keg- hook, tooth + eye → PIE root *okw- "to see；看见

ipomoea.definitionCn: n. 番薯（包括白薯，山芋，地瓜）；番薯属植物（包括圆叶牵牛，紫花牵牛）
englishDefinitions: morning glory

lead-acid.definitionCn: adj. 铅酸的，铅酸蓄电池的，用于 lead-acid battery（铅酸电池）等搭配
lead-acid.formation: PIE root *leit- (2) "to go forth"；去 + PIE root *ak- "be sharp, rise (out) to a point, pierce"；尖锐、升起、刺穿

englishDefinitions: ridleys
lepidochelys.formation: lepid-（希腊语 lepis，鳞片） + -chelys（希腊语 chelys，龟）

long-absent.definitionCn: adj．长时间缺席的：指某人或某物在很长一段时间内未出现或未参与某事。
long-absent.formation: ab-（离开、远离） + PIE root *del- (1)-long；长 + Latin ab-off, away from；离开、远离 + PIE root *es- "to be"；存在

englishDefinitions: extinct genus: mammoths
mammuthus.formation: mammoth（英语借自俄语 mammot'；更早可能来自西伯利亚北部语言，来源不确定） + -us（拉丁化科学属名词尾）

englishDefinitions: the quality of being measurable
measurability.formation: PIE root *me- (2) "to measure."；测量 + -ability（性质名词后缀）

monarchical.definitionCn: adj. 君主的，国王的；君主政治的，君主政体的，君主制的
englishDefinitions: having the characteristics of or befitting or worthy of a monarch；ruled by or having the supreme power resting with a monarch
monarchical.formation: Greek monos-single, alone；单一、独自 + Greek arkhein "be the first," thence "to begin, begin from or with, make preparation for;"；第一 + -ical（形容词后缀）

monotreme.definitionCn: n. 单孔目动物；单孔类动物
englishDefinitions: the most primitive mammals comprising the only extant members of the subclass Prototheria

monzonite.formation: Monzoni（意大利多洛米蒂山地名，岩石类型以其命名） + -ite（表示矿物/岩石名称的后缀）

moonlet.formation: *me(n)ses- moon, month；月亮、月份 + -let（小称后缀）

natural-habitat.definitionCn: 自然栖息地：指生物种群在自然界中生存和繁殖的自然环境，包括其所需的气候、土壤、水源、植被等因素。
natural-habitat.formation: Latin nasci-to be born；存在 + PIE root *ghabh- "to give or receive."；给予、接收 + -al（与……有关的形容词后缀）

nigerian-born.definitionCn: adj．尼日利亚出生的：指在尼日利亚出生的人，通常表示这个人具有尼日利亚的国籍或文化背景。

nonforested.definitionCn: adj. 非森林覆盖的：指没有森林覆盖或树木稀少的地区。
nonforested.formation: non-；不、非 + PIE root *per- (1)-forward；向前、前进 + PIE root *dhwer- "door, doorway"；门、门道 + -ed（过去式/过去分词后缀）

nonperishable.definitionCn:
adj. 不易损坏的
n. 不易损坏之物
nonperishable.formation: non-（不、非） + PIE root *ne- "not."；不、非 + PIE root *per- (1)-forward；向前、前进 + PIE root *ei- to go；去

englishDefinitions: in an outlandish manner
outlandishly.formation: Old English ut "out, without, outside,"；外面、向外、没有 + *lendh- (2)-land, open land, heath；土地、开阔地、荒原 + -ly（副词/形容词后缀）

point-of-view.definitionCn:
观点：对某事物的考虑方式。
角度：对某事物的看法或评价。
point-of-view.formation: point → PIE root *peuk- "to prick"；刺、扎 + view → Old French voir-"to see"；看见

priestess.definitionCn: n. 女祭司（尤指非基督教宗教中的女性神职人员）；（常作 high priestess）某一领域或运动的女性领袖
englishDefinitions: a woman priest
priestess.formation: Greek presby- old；古老 + -ess（表示女性的后缀）

raffinose.definitionCn: n. [有化] 棉子糖；[有化] 蜜三糖

sawfly.formation: PIE root *sek- "to cut."；切、割 + *pleu- to flow；流动

serialize.definitionCn: vt. （媒体/出版，常用被动）连载，连播，连映；（计算机）序列化，串行化（把数据或对象转换为可存储或传输的格式）；使成序列，按顺序排列，使连续
englishDefinitions: arrange serially
serialize.formation: PIE root *ser- (2)-"to line up."；排列成行 + -ize（动词化后缀）

signifier.definitionCn: n. （语言学、符号学）能指（语言符号中与“所指”相对的可感知形式）；记号，标志物，表示者
englishDefinitions: the phonological or orthographic sound or appearance of a word that can be used to describe or identify something
signifier.formation: Latin signum-"identifying mark, token, indication, symbol; proof; military standard, ensign; a signal, an omen; sign in the heavens, constellation."；标记、象征、证据、信号、预兆；星座 + PIE root *dhe- to set, put；放置、安放 + -er（比较级/施事名词后缀）

englishDefinitions: the quality of being well-groomed and neatly tailored；the smooth feel of silk fabric
sleekness.formation: *(s)lei- slimy, sticky, slippery；滑的 + -ness（性质/状态名词后缀）

spear-thrower.definitionCn: n. 梭标投射器，投矛器
spear-thrower.formation: *sper- (1)-spear, pole；长矛 + *tere- (1)-to rub, turn；摩擦、转动 + -er（比较级/施事名词后缀）

spoken-word.definitionCn: 口头艺术形式：一种口头艺术形式，通常由表演诗歌组成，尽管有时也与讲故事或说唱重叠。
spoken-word.formation: *spreg- (1)-to speak；说 + PIE *were- (3)-to speak；说 + -en（使成为……的动词后缀）

englishDefinitions: any of a genus (Stegosaurus) of stegosaurs known from the Upper Jurassic rocks especially of Colorado and Wyoming

sub-national.formation: sub-；在下、次于 + Latin nasci-to be born；存在 + -tion（动作、过程或结果名词后缀） + -al（与……有关的形容词后缀）

sugar-maples.definitionCn: 枫树：一种生长在北美东部的枫树，其叶子有3到5个叶裂，木材坚硬且纹理紧密，常用于制作家具，其汁液是制作枫糖和枫糖浆的主要来源。
sugar-maples.formation: sugar（糖；经古法语/拉丁语回溯至阿拉伯语 sukkar，最终源头更早） + maple（枫树；古英语 mapul，词源更早不确定） + -s（复数后缀）

englishDefinitions: Of or pertaining to a tegument or tegmentum; as, the tegmental layer of the epiblast; the tegmental cells of the taste buds.
tegmental.formation: teg-/tegere（覆盖；拉丁语“覆盖”） + -al（“与……有关的”形容词后缀） + -mentum（表示工具、结果或名词的拉丁构词成分，见 tegmentum）

ten-point.definitionCn: adj．十分的，完美的：用于形容某事物达到了最高水平或完美状态。
ten-point.formation: PIE root *dekm- ten；十 + PIE root *peuk- "to prick"；刺、扎

thrum.definitionCn:
n. （常作单数）低沉的连续声，嗡嗡声；轻敲（声）；乱弹（声）；（纺织，常用复数）织边，绳毛，短纱头；（植物）短花柱型，短花柱花
v. （不及物）发出低沉的连续声，嗡嗡作响；（及物／不及物）弹拨（弦乐器），指弹，乱弹；（常与 on 或 against 连用）轻敲，叩打，敲打；（纺织，及物）把绳毛夹杂于织物，用绳毛装饰织物
englishDefinitions: a thrumming sound；sound with a monotonous hum

traceability.definitionCn: n. 可追溯性，可追踪性，跟踪能力，指通过记录、编号或标识等追溯并核实物品历史、位置、流转或应用的能力；（计量学）溯源性，指测量结果通过不间断并有文件记录的校准链与规定参考相联系的特性；（软件工程）需求可追溯性，指在需求与其来源、设计、实现、测试和验证之间建立并维护追踪关联的能力

v. 感染，传染（infect 的过去式和过去分词）
englishDefinitions: containing or resulting from disease-causing organisms
infected.formation: PIE root *en "in."；在内 + PIE root *dhe- to set, put；放置、安放 + -ed（过去式/过去分词后缀）

infecund.definitionCn: adj. 不孕的；不结果的；不毛的（等于 infertile）
englishDefinitions: not fecund
infecund.formation: in-（不、非；进入、向内） + PIE root *ne- "not"；不、非 + PIE root *dhe(i)- to suck, suckle；吸吮、哺乳

englishDefinitions: the quality or state of being infinite : infiniteness
infinitude.formation: in-（不、非；进入、向内） + PIE root *ne- "not"；不、非 + Latin finis-boundary, end；边界、末端

infix.definitionCn:
n. 中缀；中加成分
v. 把……植入；插入（中缀）；用力插入
adj. 中缀的
englishDefinitions: to fasten or fix by piercing or thrusting in
infix.formation: in-（不、非；进入、向内） + PIE root *en "in"；在内、进入 + PIE root *dheigw- to stick, fix；粘住

inflamed.definitionCn:
adj. 发炎的；红肿的
v. 使发炎（inflame的过去分词）；使燃烧；使火红；激起
englishDefinitions: red, painful and hot because of infection or injury
inflamed.formation: in-（不、非；进入、向内） + PIE root *en "in"；在内、进入 + PIE root *bhel- (1) "to shine, flash, burn."；发光、闪烁、燃烧 + -ed（过去式或过去分词后缀）

inflated.definitionCn:
adj. 通货膨胀的；充了气的；价格飞涨的；（植物）肿胀的
v. 膨胀（inflate的过去式和过去分词）；使充气；抬高（物价）
夸张的，虚华的，被放大的/exaggerated; pompous; enlarged (with air or gas). His claims about the new product were inflated, it did not work as well as he had promised.
englishDefinitions: higher than is acceptable or reasonable
inflated.formation: PIE root *en "in"；在内、进入 + PIE root *bhle- "to blow."；吹 + -ed（过去式或过去分词后缀）

inflect.definitionCn:
vt. 弯曲；改变；使屈曲
vi. 发生曲折变化
englishDefinitions: to change the form of a word according to its grammatical
inflect.formation: PIE root *en "in"；在内、进入 + Latin flectere "to bend"；弯曲

englishDefinitions: To inflex something is to bend or deflect it.
inflex.formation: in-（不、非；进入、向内） + PIE root *en "in"；在内、进入 + Latin flectere "to bend"；弯曲

englishDefinitions: the mode of development and arrangement of flowers on an axis
inflorescence.formation: in-（不、非；进入、向内） + PIE root *en "in"；在内、进入 + Latin florem "flower"；花

influenced.definitionCn:
v. 影响，对……起作用（influence 的过去式和过去分词）
adj. 受影响的，受…影响的
influenced.formation: PIE root *en "in"；在内、进入 + PIE root *bhel- (2) "to blow, swell"；吹、膨胀 + -ed（过去式/过去分词后缀）

informed.definitionCn:
adj. 见多识广的；消息灵通的；有根据的；明智的（猜测或决定）
v. 通知；使了解；提供资料（inform的过去式和过去分词）
englishDefinitions: having or showing a lot of knowledge about a particular subject or situation
informed.formation: in-（不、非；进入、向内） + PIE root *en "in"；在内、进入 + Latin forma "form, contour, figure, shape"；形状、轮廓、形式 + -ed（过去式或过去分词后缀）

englishDefinitions: one that adheres to the doctrine of infralapsarianism compare supralapsarian
infralapsarian.formation: Latin infra-below；在下方、低于 + Latin labi-"to glide, slip, slide, sink, fall; decline, go to ruin,"；滑行

ingrained.definitionCn:
adj. 根深蒂固的；彻头彻尾的；生染的
v. 使根深蒂固（ingrain的过去分词形式）；生染；就原料染色
牢固的；深深扎根的；深入人心的/deeply established; firmly rooted. Try as they would, the missionaries were unable to uproot the ingrained superstitions of the natives.
englishDefinitions: that has existed for a long time and is therefore difficult to change
ingrained.formation: in-（不、非；进入、向内） + PIE root *en "in."；在内 + *gre-no- grain；谷物、颗粒 + -ed（过去式或过去分词后缀）

inguinal.definitionCn: adj. [解剖][动] 腹股沟的；鼠蹊部的
englishDefinitions: of, relating to, or situated in the region of the groin or in either of the lowest lateral regions of the abdomen
the act of devouring or swallowing
ingurgitation.formation: PIE root *en "in"；在内、进入 + PIE root *gwora- "food, devouring."；食物；吞食 + -ation（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

inherited.definitionCn:
adj. 遗传的；继承权的；通过继承得到的
v. 继承；经遗传而得（inherit的过去分词）
englishDefinitions: to receive from an ancestor as a right or title descendible by law at the ancestor's death
inherited.formation: PIE root *en "in"；在内、进入 + Latin haerere-to adhere, stick, cling；附着 + -ed（过去式或过去分词后缀）

inhibited.definitionCn:
adj. 抑制的，受抑制的；禁止的；拘谨的，拘束的，羞怯的
v. inhibit 的过去式和过去分词，意为“抑制；控制；禁止”
englishDefinitions: held back or restrained or prevented
inhibited.formation: PIE root *en "in"；在内、进入 + PIE root *ghabh- "to give or receive."；给予、接收 + -ed（过去式/过去分词后缀）

englishDefinitions: the act of burying dead people, used especially in relation to ancient times
inhumation.formation: PIE root *en "in."；在内 + Latin humus-earth, soil；土地、地球 + -ation（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

englishDefinitions: in or into the middle of a narrative or plot
inmediasres.formation: PIE root *ne- "not"；不、非 + PIE root *medhyo- "middle"；中间

innervate.definitionCn: v. 使受神经支配；使神经分布于；刺激活动
englishDefinitions: to supply with nerves
innervate.formation: PIE *(s)neu- "tendon, sinew"；筋腱 + in- "in"；不、非；进入、向内 + -ate（动词/形容词构词后缀）

innocuity.definitionCn: n. 无害；没有害处的消遣；无伤大雅的言行
englishDefinitions: the quality or state of being innocuous

inobservant.definitionCn: adj. 不遵守的；不注意的；疏忽的
englishDefinitions: Inobservant describes something that is not consciously observing.
inobservant.formation: in-（不、非；进入、向内） + PIE root *ne- "not"；不、非 + ob- toward; against; before; near; across; down,；朝向、对着；在前、附近、横过或向下 + PIE root *ser- (1)-to protect；保护

inofficious.definitionCn: adj. 没有用的；无职务的；不尽道德上义务的
englishDefinitions: a will made in violation of natural duty and affection and without just legal cause and depriving children and parents and sometimes others of their legitim of the testator's estate
inofficious.formation: in-（在内、进入；否定构词时也可表示“不”） + PIE root *ne- "not"；不、非 + Latin opus "work,"；工作

inornate.definitionCn: adj. 不加修饰的；朴素的

inornate.formation: in-（不、非；进入、向内） + PIE root *ne- "not"；不、非 + Latin ornare "prepare, furnish, adorn, fit out,"；准备

inquiline.definitionCn:
n. 寄居动物
adj. 寄居动物的
englishDefinitions: an animal that lives habitually in the nest or abode of some other species
inquiline.formation: in- "in"；不、非；进入、向内 + latin colere-to inhabit,till；居住、耕作

inquiring.definitionCn:
adj. 询问的，打听的，爱追究的（同 enquiring）
v. 打听；调查（inquire 的现在分词，同 enquire）
englishDefinitions: showing an interest in learning new things
inquiring.formation: in-（不、非；进入、向内） + Latin quaere-to ask, inquire；询问、探究 + -ing（动名词或现在分词后缀）

englishDefinitions: Insatiate describes a desire or appetite that cannot be satisfied.
insatiate.formation: in-（不、非；进入、向内） + PIE root *ne- "not"；不、非 + PIE root *sa- "to satisfy."；使满足

englishDefinitions: an insect repellent
insectifuge.formation: PIE root *en "in"；在内、进入 + Latin sectio-"a cutting, cutting off, division,"；分组 + PIE root *bheug- "to flee"；逃跑

inseminate.definitionCn: vt. 使受胎；栽植；人工授精
englishDefinitions: to put sperm
inseminate.formation: PIE root *en "in."；在内 + latin semen-seed；种子 + PIE root *sē- "to sow,"；播种

englishDefinitions: the fact that two or more things cannot be separated
inseparability.formation: PIE root *ne- "not"；不、非 + se- "apart"；分开 + Latin parare "make ready, prepare"；准备

inserted.definitionCn:
adj. 插入的，嵌入的；（生物学、解剖学）附着的，着生的
v. insert 的过去式和过去分词
englishDefinitions: Situated upon, attached to, or growing out of, some part; -- said especially of the parts of the flower; as, the calyx, corolla, and stamens of many flowers are inserted upon the receptacle.
inserted.formation: PIE root *en "in"；在内、进入 + PIE root *ser- (2)-"to line up."；排列成行 + -ed（过去式/过去分词后缀）

englishDefinitions: lacking wisdom : stupid
insipient.formation: PIE root *ne- "not"；不、非 + PIE root *sep- (1)-to taste, perceive；感知

insobriety.definitionCn: n. 无节制；头脑不清醒；酗酒
englishDefinitions: lack of sobriety or moderation
insobriety.formation: PIE root *ne- "not"；不、非 + Latin sed- "without, apart, aside,"；没有 + Latin ebrius-drunk + in- "not, opposite of"；不、非；相反

insolation.definitionCn: n. 日晒；日光浴；[内科] 中暑；[内科] 日射病
englishDefinitions: exposure to the sun's rays
insolation.formation: PIE root *en "in."；在内 + PIE root *sawel- "the sun"；太阳 + -ation（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

insomnious.definitionCn: adj. 患失眠症的，失眠的

insomnious.formation: PIE root *ne- "not"；不、非 + PIE root *swep- "to sleep"；睡觉

inspired.definitionCn:
adj. 品质优秀的；能力卓越的；借助于灵感创作的；受……影响的；（空气等物质）吸入的；基于宗教、政治等原因
v. 激发，鼓舞（inspire 的过去式和过去分词）
受激励
englishDefinitions: having excellent qualities or abilities; produced with the help of inspiration
inspired.formation: in-（不、非；进入、向内） + PIE root *en "in"；在内、进入 + Latin spirare-to breathe；呼吸 + -ed（过去式或过去分词后缀）

englishDefinitions: to make thick or thicker

inspissation.definitionCn: n. 浓缩；蒸浓法，浓缩法

inspissation.formation: PIE root *en "in"；在内、进入 + Latin spissus-"thick, dense, compact, close"；关闭 + -ation（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

institutionalized.definitionCn:
adj. 约定俗成的，使成惯例的；有组织的；（因长期生活在福利机构）缺乏自理能力的；制度化的
v. 将（人）送到收容机构；使成为惯例；制度化（institutionalize 的过去式和过去分词）

englishDefinitions: an act or the action of blowing on, into, or in: such as

insularism.definitionCn: n. 岛国特性；胸襟狭窄
englishDefinitions: the quality or state of being insular and especially of exhibiting narrowness and rigidity of outlook or mind

insulated.definitionCn:

adj. 有隔热（或隔音、绝缘）保护的
分离；隔离/set apart; isolated. A well-to-do bachelor, James spent his money freely, insulated from the cares of his friends, who had families to support.
englishDefinitions: protected with a material that prevents heat, sound, electricity, etc. from passing through

insulating.definitionCn:

insured.definitionCn:

insusceptible.definitionCn: adj. 不为所动的；不受感动的；不受……影响的

integrated.definitionCn:
adj. 综合的；完整的；互相协调的
v. 整合；使…成整体（integrate的过去分词）
englishDefinitions: in which many different parts are closely connected and work successfully together

integument.definitionCn: n. 覆盖物；（动植物的）皮肤，外皮
englishDefinitions: something that covers or encloses
integument.formation: in-（不、非；进入、向内） + PIE root *en "in"；在内、进入 + *(s)teg- to cover；覆盖

intended.definitionCn:
adj. 预期的，打算中的；为……打算（或设计）的；故意的，蓄意的
n. <非正式>未婚夫，未婚妻
v. 意指，意思是；计划，打算；准备，预留（作某种用途或给某人用）（intend 的过去式和过去分词形式）

intending.definitionCn:

adj. 有意图的，预计中的，未来的；（人）计划成为……的

englishDefinitions: Mutual or reciprocal relation; correlation.

englishDefinitions: occurring or existing in the time between wars and especially between the First and Second World Wars
inter-war.formation: inter-（在……之间、相互） + Latin inter (prep., adv.) "among, between, betwixt, in the midst of"；在……之间 + *wers- (1)-to confuse, mix up；混合、向上

englishDefinitions: to blend together : intermingle
interblend.formation: inter-（在……之间、相互） + Latin inter (prep., adv.) "among, between, betwixt, in the midst of"；在……之间 + PIE root *bhel- (1) "to shine, flash, burn."；发光、闪烁、燃烧

interconnected.definitionCn:

interconnected.formation: Latin inter (prep., adv.) "among, between, betwixt, in the midst of"；在……之间 + Latin cum "together, together with, in combination,"；一起、共同、结合 + PIE root *ned- to bind, tie；捆绑、系、绑 + -ed（过去式/过去分词后缀）

intercrural.definitionCn:
脚间的
股间的
腿间的

interdepartmental.definitionCn: adj. 不同部门间的；不同学科间的

interfaith.definitionCn: adj. 不同宗教信仰者的

interfaith.formation: inter-（在……之间、相互） + Latin inter (prep., adv.) "among, between, betwixt, in the midst of"；在……之间 + Latin fidere-to trust；信任

interflow.definitionCn:
n. 交流；合流
vi. 合流
englishDefinitions: a flowing into one another : a mixing together
interflow.formation: inter-（在……之间、相互） + Latin inter (prep., adv.) "among, between, betwixt, in the midst of"；在……之间 + *pleu- to flow；流动

interlanguage.definitionCn:

adj. 不同语言间的
