translated.definitionCn:
v. 翻译，译成（translate 的过去式和过去分词）；转化为，转变为（常与 into 连用）
adj. 译成的，翻译过来的（常作定语）
translated.formation: Latin trans (prep.) "across, over, beyond,"；横过、越过、超出 + Latin ātus "borne, carried"；承载、携带 + -ed（过去式/过去分词后缀）

englishDefinitions: an act, process, or instance of transliterating
transliteration.formation: Latin trans (prep.) "across, over, beyond,"；横过、越过、超出 + Latin littera-"letter of the alphabet," also "an epistle, writing, document; literature, great books; science, learning;"；字母 + -ation（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

transmitted.definitionCn:
adj. 传播的；被传送的；透射的
v. 传输，传送（transmit 的过去式和过去分词）
englishDefinitions: occurring among members of a family usually by heredity
transmitted.formation: Latin trans (prep.) "across, over, beyond,"；横过、越过、超出 + Latin mittere-to release, let go; send, throw; to put, place；释放、发送、投掷、放置 + -ed（过去式/过去分词后缀）

englishDefinitions: Transnormal describes something that goes beyond or differs from the usual standard.
transnormal.formation: trans-（横过、穿过、转变） + Latin trans (prep.) "across, over, beyond,"；横过、越过、超出 + Latin norma-"carpenter's square, rule, pattern,"；木工直角尺；规则、模式

transplantable.definitionCn: adj. 可移植的，可移种的
englishDefinitions: capable of being transplanted
transplantable.formation: Latin trans (prep.) "across, over, beyond,"；横过、越过、超出 + PIE root *plat- "to spread"；铺开 + -able（可…的形容词后缀）

transpontine.definitionCn: adj. 桥那边的；泰晤士河南岸的
englishDefinitions: situated on the farther side of a bridge
transpontine.formation: Latin trans "across, over, beyond,"；横过 + pons-bridge

transsexual.definitionCn:
n. 换性者；改变性别的人
adj. 改变性别的；两性间的
englishDefinitions: of, relating to, or being a person whose gender identity differs from the sex the person was identified as having at birth : transgender
transsexual.formation: trans-（横过、穿过、转变） + Latin trans (prep.) "across, over, beyond,"；横过、越过、超出 + Latin sexus "a sex, state of being either male or female, gender,"；状态

transsexualism.definitionCn: n. 易性症；改变性别；异性认同癖
englishDefinitions: of, relating to, or being a person whose gender identity differs from the sex the person was identified as having at birth : transgender
transsexualism.formation: trans-（横过、穿过、转变） + Latin trans (prep.) "across, over, beyond,"；横过、越过、超出 + Latin sexus "a sex, state of being either male or female, gender,"；状态 + -ism（表示主义、体系、学说或做法的名词后缀）

transubstantiation.definitionCn: n. 变质；改变；圣餐变体论
englishDefinitions: the miraculous change by which according to Roman Catholic and Eastern Orthodox dogma the eucharistic elements at their consecration become the body and blood of Christ while keeping only the appearances of bread and wine
transubstantiation.formation: Latin trans (prep.) "across, over, beyond,"；横过、越过、超出 + Latin preposition sub "under, below, beneath, at the foot of," also "close to, up to, towards;" of time, "within, during;" figuratively "subject to, in the power of;" also "a little, somewhat"；在下方 + PIE root *sta- "to stand, make or be firm."；站立；使稳固 + -ation（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

transvestite.definitionCn:
n. 异性装扮癖者，易装癖者
adj. 爱穿异性服装的，易装癖的
englishDefinitions: a person who wears clothes designed for the opposite sex : a cross-dresser
transvestite.formation: Latin trans (prep.) "across, over, beyond,"；横过、越过、超出 + PIE root *eu- "to dress"；穿衣、装饰

trapped.definitionCn:
adj. 受困的，受限制的
v. 诱捕；使陷入圈套；使陷入困境（trap 的过去式和过去分词形式）
困住的,被困住的,陷入的
englishDefinitions: forced to turn and face attackers
trapped.formation: PIE *der- (1)-to run, walk, step；跑 + -ed（过去式/过去分词后缀）

traumatise.definitionCn: vt. （traumatize 的英式拼写）使受到心理创伤，使精神受到创伤；（医学）使受损伤，使遭受身体创伤
englishDefinitions: inflict a trauma upon
traumatise.formation: *tere- (1)-to rub, turn；摩擦、转动 + -ise（动词化后缀）

travelling.definitionCn:
adj. 巡回的，巡演的；旅行用的
n. 旅行；（篮球比赛中的）走步
v. （尤指长途）旅行；走动，移动；（以某速度、朝某方向或在某距离内）行进（travel 的现在分词）
旅游
englishDefinitions: the act of going from one place to another
travelling.formation: PIE root *trei- three；三 + PIE root *pag- "to fasten."；固定、系牢 + -ing（动名词/现在分词后缀）

trawler.definitionCn: n. 拖网渔船；拖网捕鱼的人
englishDefinitions: a fisherman who use a trawl net；a fishing boat that uses a trawl net or dragnet to catch fish
trawler.formation: *dhregh- to draw, drag on the ground；地面 + -er（比较级/施事名词后缀）

treading.definitionCn:
v. tread 的现在分词：行走；踩踏；踩碎；treading water：踩水；停滞不前
n. 胎面翻新
treading.formation: PIE *der- (1)-to run, walk, step；跑 + -ing（动名词/现在分词后缀）

treasured.definitionCn:
adj. 珍贵的，珍视的，重视的，心爱的，珍藏的（多用于名词前作定语）
v. treasure 的过去式和过去分词（珍藏，珍爱，重视）
englishDefinitions: characterized by feeling or showing fond affection for
treasured.formation: PIE root *dhe- to set, put；放置、安放 + -ed（过去式/过去分词后缀）

treated.definitionCn:
v. treat 的过去式和过去分词：治疗；对待、看待；处理、加工；款待、招待
adj. treat 的过去分词作形容词：经治疗的；已处理过的
englishDefinitions: subjected to a physical (or chemical) treatment or action or agent；given medical care or treatment
treated.formation: *tragh- to draw, drag, move；拉、拖、移动 + -ed（过去式/过去分词后缀）

treatment-resistant.formation: *tragh- to draw, drag, move；拉、拖、移动 + Latin re-"again; back; anew, against."；再次、回返、重新；对抗 + PIE root *sta- "to stand, make or be firm."；站立；使稳固 + -ment（动作、过程或结果名词后缀）

trembling.definitionCn:
n. 发抖，战栗，颤动；担心
adj. 发抖的，战栗的，哆嗦的
v. （tremble 的现在分词）通常因寒冷、害怕或情绪激动而颤抖，发抖，战栗；颤动；极担心
englishDefinitions: a shaky motion；vibrating slightly and irregularly; as e.g. with fear or cold or like the leaves of an aspen in a breeze
trembling.formation: PIE *trem- "to tremble"；颤抖 + -ing（动名词/现在分词后缀）

trepan.definitionCn:
n. 环锯；钻孔机
vt. 欺骗；诱入圈套；用环锯行手术
englishDefinitions: a tool used to make a hole in the skull of a person

triaxial.definitionCn: adj. 三轴的；三维的；空间的
englishDefinitions: having or involving three axes
triaxial.formation: PIE root *trei- three；三 + PIE *aks- axis；轴 + tri-（三、三倍）

englishDefinitions: a form of sexual activity between women in which the external genitalia are rubbed together
tribadism.formation: *tere- (1)-to rub, turn；摩擦、转动 + PIE root *tere- (1) "to rub, turn"；摩擦 + -ism（表示主义、体系、学说或做法的名词后缀）

tricentennial.definitionCn:
adj. 三百年的；三百周年纪念的
n. 三百周年
englishDefinitions: Tricentennial describes something related to or completing a period of 300 years.
tricentennial.formation: PIE root *trei- three；三 + Latin centum "one hundred"；一 + Latin annus-year；年 + tri-（三、三倍）

englishDefinitions: Tricep is any skeletal muscle having three origins (but especially the triceps brachii).
tricep.formation: PIE root *trei- three；三 + Greek kephalē-head, uppermost or top part, source；头、顶部、部分

tricuspid.definitionCn:
n. 三尖瓣
adj. 三尖的
englishDefinitions: having three cusps

tried.definitionCn:
adj. 经过验证的，可靠的
v. 试图，努力；试用，试做，试验；品尝（try 的过去式和过去分词形式）
englishDefinitions: tested and proved useful or correct；tested and proved to be reliable
a bet in which somebody tries to predict the first three finishers in a race in the correct order
trifecta.formation: PIE root *trei- three；三 + tri-（三、三倍）

trifid.definitionCn: adj. 三（分）裂的；（古式汤匙）匙柄三凹口的
englishDefinitions: being deeply and narrowly cleft into three teeth, processes, or points
trifid.formation: PIE root *trei- three；三 + -fid（分裂、分叉；Latin findere“劈开”）

trifling.definitionCn:
adj. 微不足道的；轻浮的
v. 浪费，闲聊（trifle的现在分词）
不重要的/trivial; unimportant. Why bother going to see a doctor for such a trifling, everyday cold?
englishDefinitions: small and not important
trifling.formation: PIE root *trei- three；三 + PIE root *(h)uebh- "to weave;" also "to move quickly"；编织 + -ing（动名词或现在分词后缀）

trifocals.definitionCn:
adj. （眼镜）有三焦距的
n. 三焦距眼镜
englishDefinitions: glasses with lenses that are divided into three parts, with the upper third for looking at things far away, the middle third for looking at things in the middle distance, and the lower third for reading or for looking at things that are near
of or relating to the trigeminal nerve

trigon.definitionCn:
n. （占星术12宫中隔120度的）三宫之一组；三角琴；三角形
n. （Trigon）人名；（法）特里贡
englishDefinitions: Trigon is (astrology) one of four groups of the zodiac where each group consists of three signs separated from each other by 120 degrees.
trigon.formation: PIE root *trei- three；三 + PIE root *ang-/*ank- "to bend"；弯曲 + PIE root *genu- (1) "knee; angle."；膝；角

trilateral.definitionCn:
adj. 有三边的
n. 三角形
englishDefinitions: involving three groups of people or three countries
trilateral.formation: PIE root *trei- three；三 + Latin latus "the side, flank of humans or animals, lateral surface,"；表面 + tri-（三、三倍）

trilemma.definitionCn: n. 三难选择的窘境；三难困境；三难推理
englishDefinitions: a state of things in which it is difficult to determine which one of three courses to pursue
trilemma.formation: PIE root *trei- three；三 + PIE root *(s)lagw- to seize, take；抓住

englishDefinitions: a period of three months during the time when a woman is pregnant
trimester.formation: PIE root *trei- three；三 + PIE root *me- (2) "to measure."；测量

trimeter.definitionCn:
n. 三音步；三音格；三音格的诗
adj. 三音步的；三音格的
englishDefinitions: a line of verse consisting of three dipodies or three metrical feet
trimeter.formation: PIE root *trei- three；三 + PIE root *me- (2) "to measure."；测量

trinomial.definitionCn:
n. （代数）三项式；三名法
adj. （代数）三项式的；三名（法）的
三相式
englishDefinitions: a polynomial of three terms
trinomial.formation: PIE root *trei- three；三 + PIE root *no-men- "name"；名称 + tri-（三、三倍）

tripoli.definitionCn:
n. 硅藻岩；硅藻土
n. （Tripoli）人名；（意、葡）的黎波里
englishDefinitions: Tripoli is a weathered and decomposed siliceous limestone; in powdered form it is used in polishing.
tripoli.formation: PIE root *trei- three；三 + Greek polis, ptolis "citadel, fort, city, one's city; the state, community, citizens,"；公民

triptych.definitionCn: n. 三幅一联；三张相联
englishDefinitions: a picture (such as an altarpiece) or carving in three panels side by side
triptych.formation: PIE root *trei- three；三 + Greek ptykhe "fold,"；折叠

englishDefinitions: fear of the number 13
triskaidekaphobia.formation: Greek phobos "fear"；恐惧 + -phobia（恐惧、厌恶） + /ia-word-forming element in names of countries, diseases, and flowers,；表示国家、疾病或花名的构词后缀

triskelion.definitionCn: n. （从中心点辐射的）三曲枝图；三曲臂图；三曲腿图（等于 triskele）
englishDefinitions: a figure composed of three usually curved or bent branches radiating from a center

trisomy.definitionCn: n. 三染色体细胞；三染色体性
englishDefinitions: the condition (as in Down syndrome) of having one or a few chromosomes triploid in an otherwise diploid set
trisomy.formation: PIE root *trei- three；三 + tri-（三、三倍） + -y（名词/形容词构词后缀，依词源语境）

englishDefinitions: an amphidiploid hybrid between wheat and rye having protein-rich grain
triticale.formation: *tere- (1)-to rub, turn；摩擦、转动 + PIE root *tere- (1) "to rub, turn"；摩擦

triturate.definitionCn:
v. 磨碎；把……研成粉末
n. 磨碎物
englishDefinitions: To triturate means to crush or bruise.
triturate.formation: *tere- (1)-to rub, turn；摩擦、转动 + PIE root *tere- (1) "to rub, turn"；摩擦

trivium.definitionCn: n. 三学科（文法、逻辑、修辞）
englishDefinitions: a group of studies consisting of grammar, rhetoric, and logic and forming the lower division of the seven liberal arts in medieval universities compare quadrivium
trivium.formation: PIE root *trei- three；三 + PIE root *(h)uebh- "to weave;" also "to move quickly"；编织

englishDefinitions: a branch of science dealing with nutrition
trophology.formation: Greek trophe-"food, nourishment,"；滋养 + -logy（学科、研究或知识领域）

tropism.definitionCn: n. 取向；向性；[生物] 趋性；向性运动
englishDefinitions: involuntary orientation by an organism or one of its parts that involves turning or curving by movement or by differential growth and is a positive or negative response to a source of stimulation
tropism.formation: PIE root *trep- to turn；转动 + -ism（表示主义、体系、学说或做法的名词后缀）

troubling.definitionCn:
adj. 令人不安的，令人烦恼的
v. trouble 的现在分词/动名词：使烦恼，使担忧；使疼痛；打扰
englishDefinitions: causing distress or worry or anxiety
troubling.formation: troubler + trobler + trubler + tourbler + turbulare + turbare + -ing（进行式/动名词词形）

trucking.definitionCn:
n. 货车运输；货车运输业；（美国英语）蔬果种植业；（旧用法）以货易货，交易
v. 用卡车运输货物或驾驶卡车（truck 的现在分词/动名词）；（旧用法）交易；打交道
englishDefinitions: the activity of transporting goods by truck
trucking.formation: trukken + troquer + trocar + -ing（动名词/现在分词后缀）

trusted.definitionCn:
adj. 可信的，可靠的，受信任的
v. trust 的过去式和过去分词：信任，信赖；相信，认为可靠；委托，托付；依靠（运气、命运等无法控制的东西）；（正式）想，希望
englishDefinitions: (of persons) worthy of trust or confidence
trusted.formation: PIE root *deru- "to be firm, solid, steadfast," also forming words for "wood, tree."；坚定 + -ed（过去式/过去分词后缀）

tubing.definitionCn:
n. 管子，管材（总称）；管道系统；导管；乘坐充气内胎在河道漂流或从雪道滑下的休闲活动；装管（管道安装）
v. 把……装管；使成管状；用管输送（tube 的现在分词）
englishDefinitions: conduit consisting of a long hollow object (usually cylindrical) used to hold and conduct objects or liquids or gases
tubing.formation: Latin tubus "tube, pipe,"；管子、管道 + -ing（动名词/现在分词后缀）

englishDefinitions: to change position or direction so as to face the other way; to make somebody/something do this

turn-on.definitionCn: n. 刺激；引起性欲的人或物
englishDefinitions: to make somebody excited or interested, especially sexually
turn-on.formation: *tere- (1)-to rub, turn；摩擦、转动 + on；在……上；继续

englishDefinitions: to be discovered to be; to prove to be
turn-out.formation: *tere- (1)-to rub, turn；摩擦、转动 + out；向外

turnbuckle.definitionCn: n. 螺丝扣，松紧螺旋扣
englishDefinitions: a device that usually consists of a link with screw threads at both ends, that is turned to bring the ends closer together, and that is used for tightening a rod or stay
turnbuckle.formation: PIE root *tere- (1) "to rub, turn"；摩擦 + Latin bucca "cheek,"(later "mouth")；嘴

turnkey.definitionCn: n. 狱吏；监狱的看守；总控钥匙；牙钥；交钥匙
englishDefinitions: complete and ready to use immediately
turnkey.formation: *tere- (1)-to rub, turn；摩擦、转动 + key；钥匙

turtleneck.definitionCn:
n. 圆翻领；高翻领毛衣
adj. 圆翻领的
englishDefinitions: a high close-fitting turnover collar used especially for sweaters
turtleneck.formation: Latin tortus "twisted,"；扭转 + Proto-Germanic *hnekk- "the nape of the neck"；颈背、后颈

tutoring.definitionCn:
v. 进行单独（或小组）辅导，指导，教导；当家庭教师，任私人教师；任大学导师（tutor 的现在分词）
n. 辅导，教导，教学
tutoring.formation: Latin tueri-"watch over, look at,"；在上方、超过、看、在 + -ing（动名词/现在分词后缀）

twinkling.definitionCn:
n. 瞬间，霎时；闪烁
adj. 闪烁的；闪亮的
v. 闪烁，闪耀；（眼睛）发光；（脚）轻快移动（twinkle 的现在分词）
闪亮的,闪烁的,亮晶晶的
englishDefinitions: a very short time
twinkling.formation: PIE root *bhel- (1) "to shine, flash, burn."；发光、闪烁、燃烧 + -ing（动名词或现在分词后缀）

twinning.definitionCn:
n. 孪生，双生；成对，配对；双晶形成；城市、地区或机构的友好结对关系
v. 使结成姊妹城市或友好地区；使（两人或两事物）成对、紧密结合、耦合或相连（twin 的现在分词）
englishDefinitions: The assemblage of two or more crystals, or parts of crystals, in reversed position with reference to each other in accordance with some definite law; also, rarely, in artificial twinning (accomplished for example by pressure), the process by which this reversal is brought about.
twinning.formation: PIE root *dwo- two；二、两个 + -ing（动名词/现在分词后缀）

twisted.definitionCn:
adj. 扭曲的，弯曲的，缠绕的；心理扭曲的；扭伤的；被歪曲的
v. twist 的过去式和过去分词（扭动；扭转；缠绕；扭曲；扭伤）
englishDefinitions: having an intended meaning altered or misrepresented
twisted.formation: PIE root *dwo- two；二、两个 + -ed（过去式/过去分词后缀）

twisting.definitionCn:
n. 扭转；缠绕；快速旋转；歪曲，曲解；诱骗（保险业中指诱使投保人转保）
adj. 曲折的，蜿蜒的；缠绕的；扭动的，蠕动的
v. twist 的现在分词：拧，扭转；缠绕；使弯曲；（使）弯曲变形；转动（身体部位）；（猛地）扭动（身体）；扭伤（脚踝等）；歪曲，曲解（事实、言论等）；指道路、河流等蜿蜒曲折
englishDefinitions: the act of distorting something so it seems to mean something it was not intended to mean；the act of rotating rapidly
twisting.formation: PIE root *dwo- two；二、两个 + -ing（动名词/现在分词后缀）

twitching.definitionCn:
n. 抽动，颤搐，抽搐
v. （使）抽动，颤动，抽搐；猛拉；夺走（twitch 的现在分词/动名词形式）
adj. 抽动的，颤搐的
englishDefinitions: a sudden muscle spasm; especially one caused by a nervous condition
twitching.formation: twicchen + twiccian + twicca + twikken + zwicken + -ing（动名词/现在分词后缀）

two-hundred.definitionCn: 二百（也作“两百”）：英语中的基数词，表示在一百九十九之后、两百零一之前的整数。
two-hundred.formation: PIE root *dwo- two；二、两个 + PIE root *dekm- ten；十 + PIE root *re- "to reason, count"；推理、计算

two-line.formation: PIE root *dwo- two；二、两个 + Latin linum-flax, linen；亚麻、亚麻布

typecast.definitionCn: v. 浇铸；使（演员）一再演出同类的角色；给……分配（合乎性格的任务）；视……为原型
englishDefinitions: if an actor is typecast
typecast.formation: Greek typtein "to strike, beat,"；击打 + Old Norse kasta-to throw；投掷

typing.definitionCn:
n. 打字，键入；（医学、生物学）分型
v. 打字；按类型把……归类（type 的现在分词）
englishDefinitions: writing done with a typewriter

unilingual.definitionCn:

uninfluenced.definitionCn: adj. 未受影响的；自主行动的；公正的

uniparous.definitionCn: adj. 每次只产一卵的；单梗的

unipersonal.definitionCn: adj. 只有一个人的；仅作为个人存在的；只适于单数人称的

unipolar.definitionCn: adj. 单极的；单尾的（神经细胞等）

univalve.definitionCn:

unlamented.definitionCn: adj. 无人惋惜的；不被哀悼的
